5.40.s:
anena nṛtyamānena jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ..
nṛtyaṃ karoti deveśa tasmādgatvā nivāraya .. 36 ..
5.40.d:
अनेन नृत्यमानेन जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ..
नृत्यं करोति देवेश तस्माद्गत्वा निवारय .. 36 ..
5.40.m: 'Since he is dancing, the world, both immovable and moving, / dances, O Lord of gods; therefore, go and stop him. 36

5.40.s:
nānyaḥ śaktaḥ suraśreṣṭha munimenaṃ kathaṃcana ..
niṣedhayitumīśāna tataḥ kuru jagaddhitam .. 37 ..
5.40.d:
नान्यः शक्तः सुरश्रेष्ठ मुनिमेनं कथंचन ..
निषेधयितुमीशान ततः कुरु जगद्धितम् .. 37 ..
5.40.m: None other, O best of gods, is in any way capable / of restraining this sage; therefore, O Īśāna, bring about the welfare of the world.' 37

5.40.s:
atha teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
kṛtvā rūpaṃ dvijeṃdrasya tatsakāśamupādravat .. 38 ..
5.40.d:
अथ तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
कृत्वा रूपं द्विजेंद्रस्य तत्सकाशमुपाद्रवत् .. 38 ..
5.40.m: Hearing their words, the Lord whose banner bears a bull, / having assumed the form of an eminent brahmin, ran up to him. 38

5.40.s:
abravīcca mune kasmāttvayaitannṛtyate'dhunā ..
tasmātkāryaṃ vadāśu tvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ .. 39 ..
5.40.d:
अब्रवीच्च मुने कस्मात्त्वयैतन्नृत्यतेऽधुना ..
तस्मात्कार्यं वदाशु त्वं परं कौतूहलं हि नः .. 39 ..
5.40.m: And he said, 'O sage, why are you dancing now? / Therefore, tell your motive quickly, for our curiosity is great.' 39

5.40.s:
evamuktaḥ sa vipreṃdraḥ śaṃkareṇa dvijottamāḥ ..
hastaṃ saṃdarśayāmāsa tasya śākarasānvitam .. 6.40.40 ..
5.40.d:
एवमुक्तः स विप्रेंद्रः शंकरेण द्विजोत्तमाः ..
हस्तं संदर्शयामास तस्य शाकरसान्वितम् .. 6.40.40 ..
5.40.m: Addressed thus by Śaṃkara, O best of brahmins, that eminent brahmin / showed him his hand covered with plant sap. 6.40.40

5.40.s:
kiṃ napaśyasi me brahmankarācchākaraso mahān..
saṃjātaḥ kṣatavaktreṇa tasmātsiddhirupasthitā .. 41 ..
5.40.d:
किं नपश्यसि मे ब्रह्मन्कराच्छाकरसो महान्..
संजातः क्षतवक्त्रेण तस्मात्सिद्धिरुपस्थिता .. 41 ..
5.40.m: 'Do you not see, O brahmin, that from my hand great plant sap / has arisen from the opening of the wound? Therefore perfection has arrived. 41

5.40.s:
etasmātkāraṇādvipra nṛtyametatkaromyaham..
ānaṃdaṃ paramaṃ prāpya siddhijaṃ siddhasattama .. 42 ..
5.40.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्विप्र नृत्यमेतत्करोम्यहम्..
आनंदं परमं प्राप्य सिद्धिजं सिद्धसत्तम .. 42 ..
5.40.m: For this reason, O brahmin, I am doing this dance, / having attained supreme bliss born of perfection, O best of perfected beings.' 42

5.40.s:
evaṃ tu vadatastasya bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
aṃguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmāsa svāṃgulyagreṇa tatkṣaṇāt .. 43 ..
5.40.d:
एवं तु वदतस्तस्य भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
अंगुष्ठं ताडयामास स्वांगुल्यग्रेण तत्क्षणात् .. 43 ..
5.40.m: While he was speaking thus, the Lord whose banner bears a bull / struck his own thumb with the tip of his finger at that very moment. 43

5.40.s:
niścakrāma tato bhasma himasphaṭikasaṃnibham..
kṣatāgrātsahasā tasya mahāvismayakārakam.. 44 ..
5.40.d:
निश्चक्राम ततो भस्म हिमस्फटिकसंनिभम्..
क्षताग्रात्सहसा तस्य महाविस्मयकारकम्.. 44 ..
5.40.m: From the wound's tip there suddenly emerged ash / resembling snow and crystal, causing great astonishment. 44

5.40.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ vipraṃ sa devo dvijasattamāḥ ..
yasyāṃguṣṭhāgrato mahyaṃ niṣkrāṃtaṃ bhasma pāṃḍuram .. 45 ..
5.40.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं विप्रं स देवो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
यस्यांगुष्ठाग्रतो मह्यं निष्क्रांतं भस्म पांडुरम् .. 45 ..
5.40.m: Then that god spoke to that brahmin, O best of brahmins: / 'I, from the tip of whose thumb white ash has come forth— 45

5.40.s:
tathāpyahaṃ muniśreṣṭha na nṛtyaṃ kartumutsahe ..
tvaṃ punarnṛtyase kasmādapi śākarasekṣaṇāt.. .. 46 ..
5.40.d:
तथाप्यहं मुनिश्रेष्ठ न नृत्यं कर्तुमुत्सहे ..
त्वं पुनर्नृत्यसे कस्मादपि शाकरसेक्षणात्.. .. 46 ..
5.40.m: even so, O best of sages, I feel no impulse to dance. / Why, then, do you dance merely at the sight of plant sap? 46

5.40.s:
virāmaṃ kuru tasmāttvaṃ nṛtyādasmādvigarhitāt ..
tapaḥ kṣarati viprendra nṛtyagītāddvijanmanaḥ .. 47 ..
athāsau tatsamudvīkṣya kṣatādbhasmavisarjanam ..
nṛtyaṃ vrīḍānvitastyaktvā tasya cakre namaskṛtim .. 40 ..
5.40.d:
विरामं कुरु तस्मात्त्वं नृत्यादस्माद्विगर्हितात् ..
तपः क्षरति विप्रेन्द्र नृत्यगीताद्द्विजन्मनः .. 47 ..
अथासौ तत्समुद्वीक्ष्य क्षताद्भस्मविसर्जनम् ..
नृत्यं व्रीडान्वितस्त्यक्त्वा तस्य चक्रे नमस्कृतिम् .. 40 ..
5.40.m:
Desist therefore from this reprehensible dance; / the austerity of a twice-born leaks away from singing and dancing, O eminent brahmin.' 47
Then, seeing that discharge of ash from the wound, / he abandoned his dance with shame and offered him obeisance. 48

5.40.s:
abravīttvāmahaṃ manye nānyaṃ devānmaheśvarāt ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ me yathā na syāttapaḥkṣatiḥ .. 49 ..
5.40.d:
अब्रवीत्त्वामहं मन्ये नान्यं देवान्महेश्वरात् ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं मे यथा न स्यात्तपःक्षतिः .. 49 ..
5.40.m: He said, 'I consider you to be none other than the god Maheśvara; / therefore, bestow grace upon me, so that there may be no loss of my austerity.' 49

5.40.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tapaste matprasādena vṛddhiṃ śasyati nityaśaḥ ..
sthāne'tra bhavatā sārdhamahaṃ sthāsyāmi sarvadā .. 6.40.50 ..
5.40.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
तपस्ते मत्प्रसादेन वृद्धिं शस्यति नित्यशः ..
स्थानेऽत्र भवता सार्धमहं स्थास्यामि सर्वदा .. 6.40.50 ..
5.40.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'By my grace your austerity shall always flourish; / in this place I will remain forever together with you. 6.40.50

5.40.s:
ānanditena bhavatā prārthito'haṃ yato mune ..
ānandeśvarasaṃjñastu khyātiṃ yāsyāmi bhūtale ..
etatpuraṃ ca me nāmnā ānandākhyaṃ bhaviṣyati .. 51 ..
5.40.d:
आनन्दितेन भवता प्रार्थितोऽहं यतो मुने ..
आनन्देश्वरसंज्ञस्तु ख्यातिं यास्यामि भूतले ..
एतत्पुरं च मे नाम्ना आनन्दाख्यं भविष्यति .. 51 ..
5.40.m: Because I was prayed to by you when you were rejoiced, O sage, / I will become famous on earth under the name Ānandeśvara; / and this city will be known as Ānanda after my name.' 51

5.40.s:
evamuktvā mahādevo gataścādarśanaṃ tataḥ ..
so'pi maṃkaṇakastatra tapastepe munīśvaraḥ .. 52 ..
5.40.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो गतश्चादर्शनं ततः ..
सोऽपि मंकणकस्तत्र तपस्तेपे मुनीश्वरः .. 52 ..
5.40.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva vanished from sight; / and that Maṅkaṇaka, the lord of sages, performed austerity there. 52

5.40.s:
atha te pannagāḥ procuḥ praṇipatya munīśvaram..
bhagavannirviṣāḥ sarve vayaṃ hi bhavatā kṛtāḥ .. 93 ..
tasmātkuru prasādaṃ no yathā syāddāruṇaṃ viṣam ..
no cedvayaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sarvaloka parābhavam.. 54 ..
.. maṃkaṇaka uvāca .. ..
anṛtaṃ na mayā proktaṃ svaireṇāpi kadācana ..
tasmādevaṃvidhāḥ sarve jalasarpā bhaviṣyatha .. 55 .. ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥprabhṛti saṃjātā jalasarpā mahītale ..
tadvadrūpā dvijihvāśca kevalaṃ viṣavarjitāḥ .. 56 ..
atha tasminhrade martyāḥ snātvā sārasvate śubhe ..
spṛṣṭvā citraśilāṃ tāṃ ca prayāṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 57 ..
atha bhītaḥ sahasrākṣo gatvā devaṃ pitāmaham ..
yamena sahitastūrṇaṃ provācedaṃ vacastadā .. 58 ..
5.40.d:
अथ ते पन्नगाः प्रोचुः प्रणिपत्य मुनीश्वरम्..
भगवन्निर्विषाः सर्वे वयं हि भवता कृताः .. 93 ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रसादं नो यथा स्याद्दारुणं विषम् ..
नो चेद्वयं गमिष्यामः सर्वलोक पराभवम्.. 54 ..
.. मंकणक उवाच .. ..
अनृतं न मया प्रोक्तं स्वैरेणापि कदाचन ..
तस्मादेवंविधाः सर्वे जलसर्पा भविष्यथ .. 55 .. ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततःप्रभृति संजाता जलसर्पा महीतले ..
तद्वद्रूपा द्विजिह्वाश्च केवलं विषवर्जिताः .. 56 ..
अथ तस्मिन्ह्रदे मर्त्याः स्नात्वा सारस्वते शुभे ..
स्पृष्ट्वा चित्रशिलां तां च प्रयांति परमां गतिम् .. 57 ..
अथ भीतः सहस्राक्षो गत्वा देवं पितामहम् ..
यमेन सहितस्तूर्णं प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा .. 58 ..
5.40.m:
Then those serpents, bowing down to the lord of sages, said: / 'O lord, we have all been rendered poisonless by you. 53
Therefore, bestow grace upon us so that we may have fierce venom; / otherwise we shall face humiliation from all people.' 54
Maṅkaṇaka said: / 'Untruth has never been spoken by me, even in jest; / therefore, all of you shall become water-serpents of such a kind.' 55
Sūta said: / From that time on, water-serpents came to be on the earth; / having the same appearance and two tongues, but completely devoid of venom. 56
Then mortals, bathing in that auspicious pool belonging to Sarasvatī / and touching that Citraśilā, attain the supreme state. 57
Then the thousand-eyed [Indra], terrified, went to the god Pitāmaha / together with Yama, and swiftly spoke these words: 58

5.40.s:
tvatprasādātsamudvīkṣya gacchaṃti manujā divam ..
pitāmaha mahātīrthaṃ yattvayā vihitaṃ kṣitau ..
sārasvataṃ narāstatra snātvā yāṃti triviṣṭapam .. 59 ..
api pāpasamācārāḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ ..
tatra snātvā śilāṃ spṛṣṭvā tadaivāyāṃti sadgatim.. 6.40.60 ..
.. yama uvāca .. ..
apramāṇaṃ vibho karma saṃprayātaṃ mamocitam ..
śubhāśubhaparijñānaṃ sarveṣāmeva dehinām .. 61 ..
tasmāttyaja tvaṃ māṃ deva yadvā tattīrthamuttamam..
yatprabhāvājjanairhīnāḥ saṃjātā narakā mama .. 62 ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yamasya prapitāmahaḥ ..
prāha pārśvasthitaṃ śakraṃ tattīrthaṃ naya saṃkṣayam .. 63 ..
tataḥ śakro hradaṃ gatvā pūrayāmāsa pāṃsubhiḥ ..
hradaṃ sārasvataṃ taṃ ca tāṃ ca citraśilāṃ dvijāḥ .. 64 ..
5.40.d:
त्वत्प्रसादात्समुद्वीक्ष्य गच्छंति मनुजा दिवम् ..
पितामह महातीर्थं यत्त्वया विहितं क्षितौ ..
सारस्वतं नरास्तत्र स्नात्वा यांति त्रिविष्टपम् .. 59 ..
अपि पापसमाचाराः सर्वधर्मबहिष्कृताः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा शिलां स्पृष्ट्वा तदैवायांति सद्गतिम्.. 6.40.60 ..
.. यम उवाच .. ..
अप्रमाणं विभो कर्म संप्रयातं ममोचितम् ..
शुभाशुभपरिज्ञानं सर्वेषामेव देहिनाम् .. 61 ..
तस्मात्त्यज त्वं मां देव यद्वा तत्तीर्थमुत्तमम्..
यत्प्रभावाज्जनैर्हीनाः संजाता नरका मम .. 62 ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा यमस्य प्रपितामहः ..
प्राह पार्श्वस्थितं शक्रं तत्तीर्थं नय संक्षयम् .. 63 ..
ततः शक्रो ह्रदं गत्वा पूरयामास पांसुभिः ..
ह्रदं सारस्वतं तं च तां च चित्रशिलां द्विजाः .. 64 ..
5.40.m:
'By your grace, men are seen going to heaven, / O Pitāmaha; at the great sacred ford that was established by you on earth / belonging to Sarasvatī, men bathe there and go to heaven. 59
Even those of sinful conduct, excluded from all duty, / having bathed there and touched the rock, attain the good state at that very moment.' 6.40.60
Yama said: / 'O all-pervading Lord, my proper function has become invalid— / the determination of the auspicious and inauspicious [deeds] of all embodied beings. 61
Therefore, O god, abandon me or [destroy] that excellent sacred ford, / by whose power my hells have become bereft of people.' 62
Hearing those words of Yama, the Great-Grandfather / said to Śakra standing beside him: 'Bring about the destruction of that sacred ford.' 63
Then Śakra went to the pool and filled it with dust— / that pool belonging to Sarasvatī and that Citraśilā, O brahmins. 64

5.40.s:
adyāpi manujaḥ samyakta sminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ ..
yaḥ karoti tapaścaryāṃ sa śīghaṃ siddhimāpnuyāt .. 65 ..
so'pi maṃkaṇakastatra sārddhaṃ devena śaṃbhunā ..
tiṣṭhatyadyāpi vipreṃdra pūritaṃ caiva pāṃsubhiḥ .. 66 ..
liṃgaṃ maṃkaṇakanyastaṃ tatrāsti sumahodayam ..
tatspṛṣṭvā mānavāḥ pāpairmucyaṃte dvijasattamāḥ .. 67 ..
māgha śuklacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sa pāpairapi saṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate .. 68 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye citraśilāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 40 .. .. cha ..
5.40.d:
अद्यापि मनुजः सम्यक्त स्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थितः ..
यः करोति तपश्चर्यां स शीघं सिद्धिमाप्नुयात् .. 65 ..
सोऽपि मंकणकस्तत्र सार्द्धं देवेन शंभुना ..
तिष्ठत्यद्यापि विप्रेंद्र पूरितं चैव पांसुभिः .. 66 ..
लिंगं मंकणकन्यस्तं तत्रास्ति सुमहोदयम् ..
तत्स्पृष्ट्वा मानवाः पापैर्मुच्यंते द्विजसत्तमाः .. 67 ..
माघ शुक्लचतुर्दश्यां यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
स पापैरपि संयुक्तः शिवलोके महीयते .. 68 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चित्रशिलामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 40 .. .. छ ..
5.40.m:
Even today, a person properly situated in that place / who performs austerity quickly attains perfection. 65
That Maṅkaṇaka also, together with the god Śambhu, / remains there even today, O eminent brahmin, though it is filled with dust. 66
The liṅga installed there by Maṅkaṇaka is of great glory; / touching it, mortals are freed from sins, O best of brahmins. 67
A man who worships it on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, / even if joined with sins, is glorified in the world of Śiva. 68
Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Citraśilā', in the Hāṭakeśvara-kṣetra-māhātmya in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 40

5.41.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasyaivottaradigbhāge devasya jalaśāyinaḥ ..
sthānamasti suvikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
5.41.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्यैवोत्तरदिग्भागे देवस्य जलशायिनः ..
स्थानमस्ति सुविख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
5.41.m: Sūta said: / In the northern region of that very god who reclines on the water, / there is a celebrated place that destroys all sins. 1

5.41.s:
yastatpūjayate bhaktyā śayane bodhane hareḥ ..
upavāsaparo bhūtvā sa gacchedvaiṣṇavaṃ padam .. 2 ..
5.41.d:
यस्तत्पूजयते भक्त्या शयने बोधने हरेः ..
उपवासपरो भूत्वा स गच्छेद्वैष्णवं पदम् .. 2 ..
5.41.m: Devoted to fasting, whoever worships it with devotion / at the sleeping and awakening of Hari goes to the realm of Viṣṇu.

5.41.s:
aśūnyaśayanānāma dvitīyā dayitā tithiḥ ..
sadaiva devadevasya kṛṣṇā suptasya yā bhavet .. 3 ..
5.41.d:
अशून्यशयनानाम द्वितीया दयिता तिथिः ..
सदैव देवदेवस्य कृष्णा सुप्तस्य या भवेत् .. 3 ..
5.41.m: The second lunar day, named Aśūnyaśayanā, / which falls in the dark fortnight when the God of gods is asleep, is forever dear [to him].

5.41.s:
tasyāṃ yaḥ pūjayettatra taṃ devaṃ jalaśāyinam..
śāstroktena vidhānena sa gacchati hareḥ padam .. 4 ..
5.41.d:
तस्यां यः पूजयेत्तत्र तं देवं जलशायिनम्..
शास्त्रोक्तेन विधानेन स गच्छति हरेः पदम् .. 4 ..
5.41.m: Whoever worships there that god who reclines on the waters / according to the rite enjoined by scripture on that [day] goes to the abode of Hari.

5.41.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
jalaśāyī kathaṃ tatra saṃprāptaḥ sūtanandana ..
pūjyate vidhinā kena tatsarvaṃ vistarādvada .. 5 ..
5.41.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
जलशायी कथं तत्र संप्राप्तः सूतनन्दन ..
पूज्यते विधिना केन तत्सर्वं विस्तराद्वद .. 5 ..
5.41.m:
The seers said:
How did he who reclines on the waters arrive there, O son of Sūta? / By what rite is he worshipped? Tell us all that in detail.

5.41.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purāsīdbāṣkalirnāma dānavendro mahābalaḥ ..
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām .. 6 ..
5.41.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरासीद्बाष्कलिर्नाम दानवेन्द्रो महाबलः ..
अजेयः सर्वदेवानां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् .. 6 ..
5.41.m:
Sūta said:
Formerly there was a lord of Dānavas named Bāṣkali, of great power, / invincible to all the gods, Gandharvas, serpents, and Rākṣasas.

5.41.s:
athāsau bhūtalaṃ sarvaṃ vaśīkṛtvā mahābalaḥ ..
tato daityagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ jagāma tridaśālayam .. 7 ..
5.41.d:
अथासौ भूतलं सर्वं वशीकृत्वा महाबलः ..
ततो दैत्यगणैः सार्द्धं जगाम त्रिदशालयम् .. 7 ..
5.41.m: Then, having subjugated the entire surface of the earth, that mighty one / went to the abode of the gods together with hosts of Daityas.

5.41.s:
tatrābhavanmahāyuddhaṃ devāsuravināśakam ..
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca kruddhānāmitaretaram .. 8 ..
5.41.d:
तत्राभवन्महायुद्धं देवासुरविनाशकम् ..
देवानां दानवानां च क्रुद्धानामितरेतरम् .. 8 ..
5.41.m: There took place a great battle destructive of gods and Asuras, / between the enraged gods and Dānavas.

5.41.s:
varṣāṇāmayutaṃ tāvadahanyahani dāruṇam ..
tatrāsṛkkardamo jātaḥ parvataścāsthi saṃbhavaḥ .. 9 ..
5.41.d:
वर्षाणामयुतं तावदहन्यहनि दारुणम् ..
तत्रासृक्कर्दमो जातः पर्वतश्चास्थि संभवः .. 9 ..
5.41.m: Dreadful, day after day, for ten thousand years, / there arose mud of blood and a mountain made of bones.

5.41.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte daśame samupasthite ..
jitastena sahasrākṣaḥ sasainyaḥ saparigrahaḥ .. 6.41.10 ..
5.41.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते दशमे समुपस्थिते ..
जितस्तेन सहस्राक्षः ससैन्यः सपरिग्रहः .. 6.41.10 ..
5.41.m: Then, when the tenth thousandth year arrived, / the thousand-eyed [Indra], with his army and retinue, was conquered by him.

5.41.s:
tataḥ svargaṃ parityajya sarvadevagaṇaiḥ saha ..
jagāma śaraṇaṃ viṣṇoḥ śvetadvīpaṃ pratiśrayam .. 11 ..
5.41.d:
ततः स्वर्गं परित्यज्य सर्वदेवगणैः सह ..
जगाम शरणं विष्णोः श्वेतद्वीपं प्रतिश्रयम् .. 11 ..
5.41.m: Then, having abandoned heaven together with all the hosts of gods, / he went for refuge to the shelter of Viṣṇu, Śvetadvīpa,

5.41.s:
yatrāste bhagavānviṣṇuryoganidrāvaśaṃgataḥ ..
śayānaḥ śeṣaparyaṃke lakṣmyā saṃvāhitāṃghriyuk .. 12 ..
5.41.d:
यत्रास्ते भगवान्विष्णुर्योगनिद्रावशंगतः ..
शयानः शेषपर्यंके लक्ष्म्या संवाहितांघ्रियुक् .. 12 ..
5.41.m: where the blessed Lord Viṣṇu stays, overcome by yogic sleep, / lying on the couch of Śeṣa, with his feet massaged by Lakṣmī.

5.41.s:
tato vedodbhavaiḥ sūktaiḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
tasya devasya sadbhaktāḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 13 ..
5.41.d:
ततो वेदोद्भवैः सूक्तैः स्तुतिं चक्रुः समंततः ..
तस्य देवस्य सद्भक्ताः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 13 ..
5.41.m: Then, with hymns originating from the Vedas, all the gods with Indra, / true devotees, praised that god on every side.

5.41.s:
athotthāya jagannāthaḥ provāca balasūdanam ..
kaccitkṣemaṃ sahasrākṣa sāṃprataṃ bhuvanatraye ..
yattvaṃ devagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ svayameva ihāgataḥ .. 14 ..
5.41.d:
अथोत्थाय जगन्नाथः प्रोवाच बलसूदनम् ..
कच्चित्क्षेमं सहस्राक्ष सांप्रतं भुवनत्रये ..
यत्त्वं देवगणैः सार्द्धं स्वयमेव इहागतः .. 14 ..
5.41.m: Then, having arisen, the Lord of the World said to the slayer of Bala: / “Is all well, O thousand-eyed one, right now in the three worlds, / since you have come here in person along with the hosts of gods?”

5.41.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
bāṣkalirnāma detyendro haralabdhavaro balī ..
ajeyaḥ saṃgare devaistenāhaṃ vijito raṇe .. 15 ..
5.41.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
बाष्कलिर्नाम देत्येन्द्रो हरलब्धवरो बली ..
अजेयः संगरे देवैस्तेनाहं विजितो रणे .. 15 ..
5.41.m:
Śakra said:
There is a powerful lord of Daityas named Bāṣkali who obtained a boon from Hara, / invincible in battle by the gods; by him I have been defeated in fight,

5.41.s:
saṃsthitiśca kṛtā svarge sāṃprataṃ madhu sūdana ..
tenaiṣa śaraṇaṃ prāpto devaiḥ sārddhaṃ surottama .. 16 ..
hiraṇyākṣabhayāddevā hiraṇyakaśipoḥ purā ..
tvayā trātā vayaṃ sarve tathānyeṣāṃ durātmanām ...7..
tasmādasmādapi trāhi dānavādbalavattarāt ..
bāṣkalernāsti deveśa tvāṃ muktvānyā parā gatiḥ ...8..
5.41.d:
संस्थितिश्च कृता स्वर्गे सांप्रतं मधु सूदन ..
तेनैष शरणं प्राप्तो देवैः सार्द्धं सुरोत्तम .. 16 ..
हिरण्याक्षभयाद्देवा हिरण्यकशिपोः पुरा ..
त्वया त्राता वयं सर्वे तथान्येषां दुरात्मनाम् ...7..
तस्मादस्मादपि त्राहि दानवाद्बलवत्तरात् ..
बाष्कलेर्नास्ति देवेश त्वां मुक्त्वान्या परा गतिः ...8..
5.41.m:
and residence in heaven has now been established [by him], O slayer of Madhu. / Therefore, O best of gods, this [one] has come for refuge along with the gods.
Formerly, O Lord, all of us were protected by you from fear of Hiraṇyākṣa / and Hiraṇyakaśipu, and likewise of other wicked souls.
Therefore protect [us] from this mightier Dānava as well; / from Bāṣkali, O Lord of gods, there is no other supreme refuge besides you.

5.41.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ taṃ nigrahīṣyāmi saṃprāpte samaye svayam..
tasmāttvaṃ samayaṃyāvatkuru śakra tapo mahat .. 19 ..
5.41.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अहं तं निग्रहीष्यामि संप्राप्ते समये स्वयम्..
तस्मात्त्वं समयंयावत्कुरु शक्र तपो महत् .. 19 ..
5.41.m:
The blessed Lord said:
I myself shall subdue him when the time has arrived; / therefore, Śakra, until that time, perform great austerity,

5.41.s:
yena te jāyate śaktistapovīryeṇa vāsava ..
vadhāya tasya daityasya balayuktasya bāṣkaleḥ .. 6.41.20 ..
5.41.d:
येन ते जायते शक्तिस्तपोवीर्येण वासव ..
वधाय तस्य दैत्यस्य बलयुक्तस्य बाष्कलेः .. 6.41.20 ..
5.41.m: by which power will arise for you through the potency of austerity, O Vāsava, / for the slaying of that mighty Daitya Bāṣkali.

5.41.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
kasminkṣetre jagannātha karomi sumahattapaḥ ..
tasya daityasya nāśārthaṃ tada smākaṃ prakīrtaya .. 21 ..
5.41.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्क्षेत्रे जगन्नाथ करोमि सुमहत्तपः ..
तस्य दैत्यस्य नाशार्थं तद स्माकं प्रकीर्तय .. 21 ..
5.41.m:
Śakra said:
In what sacred field, O Lord of the World, shall I perform very great austerity / for the destruction of that Daitya? Proclaim that to us.

5.41.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā bhagavānviṣṇuḥ provācātha puraṃdaram ..
ciraṃ manasi niścitya kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca .. 22 ..
5.41.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा भगवान्विष्णुः प्रोवाचाथ पुरंदरम् ..
चिरं मनसि निश्चित्य क्षेत्राण्यायतनानि च .. 22 ..
5.41.m:
Sūta said:
Having heard that, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu then addressed Puraṃdara, / having pondered in his mind for a long time on sacred fields and sanctuaries:

5.41.s:
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetraṃ śakra siddhipradāyakam ..
tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā tadvadhārthaṃ tapaḥ kuru .. 23 ..
5.41.d:
चमत्कारपुरं क्षेत्रं शक्र सिद्धिप्रदायकम् ..
तस्मात्तत्र द्रुतं गत्वा तद्वधार्थं तपः कुरु .. 23 ..
5.41.m: “The sacred field Camatkārapura, O Śakra, bestows perfections; / therefore, having gone there swiftly, perform austerity for his slaying.”

5.41.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
na vayaṃ bhavatā hīnā yāsyāmo'nyatra keśava ..
bāṣkalerdānavendrasya bhayādbhītāḥ kathaṃcana .. 24 ..
5.41.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
न वयं भवता हीना यास्यामोऽन्यत्र केशव ..
बाष्कलेर्दानवेन्द्रस्य भयाद्भीताः कथंचन .. 24 ..
5.41.m:
Śakra said:
Deprived of you, Keśava, we shall not go elsewhere, / being terrified out of fear of the Dānava lord Bāṣkali.

5.41.s:
tasmādāgaccha tatra tvaṃ svayameva sureśvara ..
tvayā saṃrakṣito yena karomi sumahattapaḥ .. 26 ..
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ sa bhagavānviṣṇustathetyuktvā suraiḥ saha ..
camatkārapuraṃ kṣetramājagāma saha śriyā .. .. 26 ..
5.41.d:
तस्मादागच्छ तत्र त्वं स्वयमेव सुरेश्वर ..
त्वया संरक्षितो येन करोमि सुमहत्तपः .. 26 ..
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः स भगवान्विष्णुस्तथेत्युक्त्वा सुरैः सह ..
चमत्कारपुरं क्षेत्रमाजगाम सह श्रिया .. .. 26 ..
5.41.m:
Therefore, come there yourself in person, O Lord of the gods, / so that, protected by you, I may perform very great austerity.
Sūta said:
Then that blessed Lord Viṣṇu, having said “So be it,” along with the gods / went to the sacred field Camatkārapura together with Śrī.

5.41.s:
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve tatra gatvā tadā''śramān ..
cakruḥ pṛthakpṛthagghṛṣṭāstapo'rthaṃ kṛtaniścayāḥ .. 27 ..
5.41.d:
अथ देवगणाः सर्वे तत्र गत्वा तदा'ऽश्रमान् ..
चक्रुः पृथक्पृथग्घृष्टास्तपोऽर्थं कृतनिश्चयाः .. 27 ..
5.41.m: Then all the hosts of gods, having gone there, / delighted and resolute for the sake of austerity, established separate hermitages.

5.41.s:
vāsudevo'pi saṃsmṛtya kṣīrodaṃ tatra sāgaram ..
ānināyāśu vistīrṇaṃ hrade tasminpurātane .. 28 ..
5.41.d:
वासुदेवोऽपि संस्मृत्य क्षीरोदं तत्र सागरम् ..
आनिनायाशु विस्तीर्णं ह्रदे तस्मिन्पुरातने .. 28 ..
5.41.m: Vāsudeva also, calling to mind the Ocean of Milk there, / quickly brought it, vast, into that ancient lake.

5.41.s:
cakāra śayanaṃ tatra śvetadvīpe yathā purā ..
stūyamānaḥ suraiḥ sarvaiḥ samaṃtādvinayānvitaiḥ .. 29 ..
5.41.d:
चकार शयनं तत्र श्वेतद्वीपे यथा पुरा ..
स्तूयमानः सुरैः सर्वैः समंताद्विनयान्वितैः .. 29 ..
5.41.m: He made his couch there as formerly in Śvetadvīpa, / while being praised on all sides by all the gods filled with humility.

5.41.s:
athāṣāḍhasya saṃprāpte dvitīyādivase śubhe ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe sahasrākṣaṃ svayameva bṛhaspatiḥ ..
provāca vacanaṃ ślakṣṇaṃ bāṣpavyākula locanam .. 6.41.30 ..
5.41.d:
अथाषाढस्य संप्राप्ते द्वितीयादिवसे शुभे ..
कृष्णपक्षे सहस्राक्षं स्वयमेव बृहस्पतिः ..
प्रोवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णं बाष्पव्याकुल लोचनम् .. 6.41.30 ..
5.41.m: Then, when the auspicious second day of the dark fortnight / of Āṣāḍha arrived, Bṛhaspati himself spoke gentle words / to the thousand-eyed [Indra], whose eyes were troubled with tears:

5.41.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
aśūnyaśayanānāma dvitīyādya puraṃdara ..
atīva dayitā viṣṇoḥ prasuptasya jalāśaye .. 31 ..
5.41.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
अशून्यशयनानाम द्वितीयाद्य पुरंदर ..
अतीव दयिता विष्णोः प्रसुप्तस्य जलाशये .. 31 ..
5.41.m:
Bṛhaspati said:
Today, O Puraṃdara, is the second [lunar day] named Aśūnyaśayanā, / exceedingly dear to Viṣṇu as he sleeps soundly in the reservoir of water.

5.41.s:
asyāṃ saṃpūjito viṣṇuryāvanmāsacatuṣṭayam ..
dadāti sakalānkāmāndhyātaścetasi sarvadā ..
śāstroktavidhinā samyagvratastho jalaśāyinam .. 32 ..
5.41.d:
अस्यां संपूजितो विष्णुर्यावन्मासचतुष्टयम् ..
ददाति सकलान्कामान्ध्यातश्चेतसि सर्वदा ..
शास्त्रोक्तविधिना सम्यग्व्रतस्थो जलशायिनम् .. 32 ..
5.41.m: Worshipped on this [day] for four months, / [and] constantly meditated upon in the mind, Viṣṇu who reclines on the waters / grants all desires [to one] undertaking the vow duly according to the scriptural rule.

5.41.s:
evaṃ sa caturo māsāndvitīyādivase harim ..
pūjayitvā sahasrākṣastejasā sahito'bhavat .. 33 ..
5.41.d:
एवं स चतुरो मासान्द्वितीयादिवसे हरिम् ..
पूजयित्वा सहस्राक्षस्तेजसा सहितोऽभवत् .. 33 ..
5.41.m: Having thus worshipped Hari on the second day for four months, / the thousand-eyed one became endowed with splendor.

5.41.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā yuktaṃ parituṣṭo janārdanaḥ ..
provāca śakra gacchādya vadhārthaṃ tasya bāṣkaleḥ ..
sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ vijayaste bhaviṣyati .. 34 ..
5.41.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तेजसा युक्तं परितुष्टो जनार्दनः ..
प्रोवाच शक्र गच्छाद्य वधार्थं तस्य बाष्कलेः ..
सर्वैर्देवगणैः सार्धं विजयस्ते भविष्यति .. 34 ..
5.41.m: Seeing him endowed with splendor, Janārdana, deeply pleased, / said: “Śakra, go today for the slaying of that Bāṣkali / together with all the hosts of gods; victory will be yours.”

5.41.s:
.. śakra uvāca .. ..
bibhemi tasya devāhaṃ dānavendrasya durmateḥ ..
tvayā vinā na gacchāmi sārdhaṃ sarvaiḥ surairapi .. 35 ..
5.41.d:
.. शक्र उवाच .. ..
बिभेमि तस्य देवाहं दानवेन्द्रस्य दुर्मतेः ..
त्वया विना न गच्छामि सार्धं सर्वैः सुरैरपि .. 35 ..
5.41.m:
Śakra said:
O Lord, I fear that evil-minded lord of Dānavas; / without you I will not go, even with all the gods.

5.41.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
tvayā saha sahasrākṣa cakrametatsudarśanam ..
gamiṣyati vadhārthāya madīyaṃ suravidviṣām .. 36 ..
5.41.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
त्वया सह सहस्राक्ष चक्रमेतत्सुदर्शनम् ..
गमिष्यति वधार्थाय मदीयं सुरविद्विषाम् .. 36 ..
5.41.m:
The blessed Lord said:
Together with you, O thousand-eyed one, this Sudarśana discus / of mine will go for the slaying of the enemies of the gods.

5.41.s:
evamuktvā hariścakraṃ pramumoca sudarśanam ..
vadhārthaṃ dānavendrāṇāṃ śakreṇa sahitaṃ tadā .. 37 ..
5.41.d:
एवमुक्त्वा हरिश्चक्रं प्रमुमोच सुदर्शनम् ..
वधार्थं दानवेन्द्राणां शक्रेण सहितं तदा .. 37 ..
5.41.m: Having spoken thus, Hari released the Sudarśana discus / at that time along with Śakra for the slaying of the lords of Dānavas.

5.41.s:
śakro'pi sahitastena gatvā cakreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
sarvānutsādayāmāsa dānavānraṇamūrdhani .. 38 ..
5.41.d:
शक्रोऽपि सहितस्तेन गत्वा चक्रेण कृत्स्नशः ..
सर्वानुत्सादयामास दानवान्रणमूर्धनि .. 38 ..
5.41.m: Accompanied by that discus, Śakra also went and completely / destroyed all the Dānavas in the forefront of battle.

5.41.s:
sa cāpi bāṣkalistena cchinnaścakreṇa kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
papāta dharaṇīpṛṣṭhe vajrāhata ivācalaḥ .. 39 ..
5.41.d:
स चापि बाष्कलिस्तेन च्छिन्नश्चक्रेण कृत्स्नशः ..
पपात धरणीपृष्ठे वज्राहत इवाचलः .. 39 ..
5.41.m: And that Bāṣkali, cut to pieces by that discus, / fell upon the surface of the earth like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

5.41.s:
tathānye bahavaḥ śūrā dānavā baladarpitāḥ ..
hatvā sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ bhūyaḥ prāptaṃ hareḥ karam.. 6.41.40 ..
5.41.d:
तथान्ये बहवः शूरा दानवा बलदर्पिताः ..
हत्वा सुदर्शनं चक्रं भूयः प्राप्तं हरेः करम्.. 6.41.40 ..
5.41.m: Having likewise slain many other heroic Dānavas arrogant with strength, / the Sudarśana discus returned once more to the hand of Hari.

5.41.s:
te'pi śakrādayo devāḥ prahṛṣṭā gatasaṃśayāḥ ..
bhūyo viṣṇuṃ sametyātha procurnatvā tataḥ param .. 41
5.41.d:
तेऽपि शक्रादयो देवाः प्रहृष्टा गतसंशयाः ..
भूयो विष्णुं समेत्याथ प्रोचुर्नत्वा ततः परम् .. 41
5.41.m: Those gods also, Indra and the rest, overjoyed and freed of doubt, / approached Viṣṇu once again and, having bowed, then spoke:

5.41.s:
prabhāvāttava deveśa hatāḥ sarve'marārayaḥ ..
prāptaṃ trailokyarājyaṃ ca bhūyo nihatakaṃṭakam .. 42 ..
5.41.d:
प्रभावात्तव देवेश हताः सर्वेऽमरारयः ..
प्राप्तं त्रैलोक्यराज्यं च भूयो निहतकंटकम् .. 42 ..
5.41.m: "By your power, O Lord of Gods, all the enemies of the gods have been slain, / and the sovereignty over the three worlds has been regained, free of thorns.

5.41.s:
tasmātkīrtaya yatkṛtyaṃ tacca śreyaskaraṃ mama ..
sadā syātpuṃḍarīkākṣa tathā śatrubhayāvaham .. 43 ..
5.41.d:
तस्मात्कीर्तय यत्कृत्यं तच्च श्रेयस्करं मम ..
सदा स्यात्पुंडरीकाक्ष तथा शत्रुभयावहम् .. 43 ..
5.41.m: Therefore tell me what duty I must perform that will bring me welfare / forever, O Lotus-eyed One, and likewise strike terror into my enemies."

5.41.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
mayātraiva sadā stheyaṃ rūpeṇānena vāsava ..
sarvalokahitārthāya hrade puṇya jalāśraye .. 44..
5.41.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
मयात्रैव सदा स्थेयं रूपेणानेन वासव ..
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय ह्रदे पुण्य जलाश्रये .. 44..
5.41.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "I must always remain right here in this form, O Vāsava, / for the welfare of all the worlds, in the pool that holds holy water.

5.41.s:
tvayā tasmātsamāgamya cāturmāsyaṃ śacīpate ..
prayatnena prakartavyamaśūnyaśayanaṃ vratam .. 45 ..
5.41.d:
त्वया तस्मात्समागम्य चातुर्मास्यं शचीपते ..
प्रयत्नेन प्रकर्तव्यमशून्यशयनं व्रतम् .. 45 ..
5.41.m: Therefore, coming here during Cāturmāsya, O husband of Śacī, / you must diligently observe the vow of Aśūnyaśayana.

5.41.s:
na bhavaṃti sahasrākṣa yena te pari paṃthinaḥ ..
tathābhīṣṭaphalāvāptirmatprasādādasaṃśayam .. 46 ..
5.41.d:
न भवंति सहस्राक्ष येन ते परि पंथिनः ..
तथाभीष्टफलावाप्तिर्मत्प्रसादादसंशयम् .. 46 ..
5.41.m: Thereby, O thousand-eyed one, you will have no adversaries, / and the attainment of your desired fruit will be assured by my grace, without doubt.

5.41.s:
anyo'pi yo naro bhaktyā pūjayiṣyati māmiha ..
saṃprāpsyati sa tām̐llokāndurlabhāṃstri daśairapi .. 47 ..
5.41.d:
अन्योऽपि यो नरो भक्त्या पूजयिष्यति मामिह ..
संप्राप्स्यति स ताम्̐ल्लोकान्दुर्लभांस्त्रि दशैरपि .. 47 ..
5.41.m: Any other man who worships me here with devotion / will also attain those worlds difficult to reach even for the gods.

5.41.s:
tasmādgaccha sahasrākṣa kuru rājyaṃ triviṣṭape ..
bhūyo'pyatraiva deveśa draṣṭavyo'smi na saṃśayaḥ ..
kāryakāle samāyāte śvetadvīpe yathā tathā .. 48 ..
5.41.d:
तस्माद्गच्छ सहस्राक्ष कुरु राज्यं त्रिविष्टपे ..
भूयोऽप्यत्रैव देवेश द्रष्टव्योऽस्मि न संशयः ..
कार्यकाले समायाते श्वेतद्वीपे यथा तथा .. 48 ..
5.41.m: Therefore go, O thousand-eyed one, and rule in heaven. / At this very spot, O Lord of Gods, I am always to be seen, without doubt, / whenever a necessity arises, just as in Śvetadvīpa."

5.41.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tataḥ praṇamya taṃ dṛṣṭvā prajagāma śatakratuḥ ..
vāsudevo'pi tatraiva sthito lokahitāya ca .. 49 ..
5.41.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततः प्रणम्य तं दृष्ट्वा प्रजगाम शतक्रतुः ..
वासुदेवोऽपि तत्रैव स्थितो लोकहिताय च .. 49 ..
5.41.m: Sūta said: / Then, having bowed and beheld him, Śatakratu departed; / Vāsudeva also remained right there for the welfare of the world.

5.41.s:
evaṃ tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā jalaśāyī janārdanaḥ ..
sarvalokahitārthāya saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ .. 6.41.50 ..
5.41.d:
एवं तत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठा जलशायी जनार्दनः ..
सर्वलोकहितार्थाय संस्थितः परमेश्वरः .. 6.41.50 ..
5.41.m: Thus, O best of brahmins, Janārdana, reclining on the waters, / the Supreme Lord, settled there for the welfare of all the worlds.

5.41.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ ..
cāturmāsye viśeṣeṇa sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 51 ..
5.41.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या श्रद्धया परया युतः ..
चातुर्मास्ये विशेषेण स याति परमां गतिम् .. 51 ..
5.41.m: Whoever worships him with devotion, endowed with supreme faith, / particularly during Cāturmāsya, attains the highest state.

5.41.s:
tathā devagaṇaiḥ sarvairdvārakā tatra sā kṛtā ..
saṃpūjya tu narā yāṃti cāturmāsye triviṣṭapam .. 52 ..
5.41.d:
तथा देवगणैः सर्वैर्द्वारका तत्र सा कृता ..
संपूज्य तु नरा यांति चातुर्मास्ये त्रिविष्टपम् .. 52 ..
5.41.m: Likewise, Dvārakā was established there by all the hosts of gods; / having worshipped [there] during Cāturmāsya, mortals go to heaven.

5.41.s:
śeṣakāle'pi cittasthānkāmānmartyaḥ samāpnuyāt ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyā sā dvārakā naraiḥ ..
sarveṣvapi hi kāleṣu cātumāsye viśeṣataḥ .. 53 ..
5.41.d:
शेषकालेऽपि चित्तस्थान्कामान्मर्त्यः समाप्नुयात् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूज्या सा द्वारका नरैः ..
सर्वेष्वपि हि कालेषु चातुमास्ये विशेषतः .. 53 ..
5.41.m: Even at other times, a mortal attains the desires residing in their heart; / therefore, with all effort, that Dvārakā must be worshipped by men / at all times, and especially during Cāturmāsya.

5.41.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
ākhyānaṃ devadevasya supuṇyaṃ jalaśāyinaḥ .. 54 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye jalaśāyyutpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 41 .. .. cha ..
5.41.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
आख्यानं देवदेवस्य सुपुण्यं जलशायिनः .. 54 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जलशाय्युत्पत्तिवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 41 .. .. छ ..
5.41.m:
All this, which destroys every transgression, has been told to you: / the most sacred narrative of the God of Gods reclining upon the waters.
Thus ends the forty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Origin of Jalaśāyin,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section], in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.42.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
viśvāmitrasamudbhūtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ tatrāparaṃ śubham ..
saṃtiṣṭhate dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sarvakāmapradāyakam .. 1 ..
5.42.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
विश्वामित्रसमुद्भूतं कुण्डं तत्रापरं शुभम् ..
संतिष्ठते द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सर्वकामप्रदायकम् .. 1 ..
5.42.m: Sūta said: / Another auspicious pool arose there from Viśvāmitra, / O best of brahmins, which grants all desires.

5.42.s:
tatra caitratṛtīyāyāṃ kṛte snāne bhavennaraḥ ..
divyarūpadharaḥ sākṣātkāmo'nyo dvijasattamāḥ .. 2 ..
5.42.d:
तत्र चैत्रतृतीयायां कृते स्नाने भवेन्नरः ..
दिव्यरूपधरः साक्षात्कामोऽन्यो द्विजसत्तमाः .. 2 ..
5.42.m: If a man performs a ritual ablution there on the third day of Caitra, / he will assume a divine form, an embodiment of Kāma himself, O foremost of brahmins.

5.42.s:
nārī vā śraddhayopetā tatra snātvā prajāvatī ..
bhavetsaubhāgyasaṃyuktā spṛhaṇīyatamā kṣitau .. 3 .. ..
5.42.d:
नारी वा श्रद्धयोपेता तत्र स्नात्वा प्रजावती ..
भवेत्सौभाग्यसंयुक्ता स्पृहणीयतमा क्षितौ .. 3 .. ..
5.42.m: Or a woman, endowed with faith, having bathed there, will have children, / will be endowed with good fortune, and will become the most coveted on earth.

5.42.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tīrthaṃ tasya munestatra kasminkāle vyavasthitam ..
nirmalaṃ kena niḥśeṣaṃ vada tvaṃ sūtanaṃdana .. 4 ..
5.42.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
तीर्थं तस्य मुनेस्तत्र कस्मिन्काले व्यवस्थितम् ..
निर्मलं केन निःशेषं वद त्वं सूतनंदन .. 4 ..
5.42.m: The seers said: / At what time was that sage's sacred ford established there, / pure and entirely unobstructed? Tell [us], O son of Sūta!

5.42.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatrāsti nirjharaḥ pūrvaṃ sāmānyo dvijasattamāḥ ..
avadhūto dharāpṛṣṭhe māhātmyena vyavasthitaḥ .. 5 ..
5.42.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रास्ति निर्झरः पूर्वं सामान्यो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
अवधूतो धरापृष्ठे माहात्म्येन व्यवस्थितः .. 5 ..
5.42.m: Sūta said: / Formerly there was an ordinary cascade there, O foremost of brahmins, / disregarded on the face of the earth, established through its majesty,

5.42.s:
yatra devanadī gaṃgā svayameva vyavasthitā ..
yasyāṃ snātaḥ pumānsadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 6 ..
5.42.d:
यत्र देवनदी गंगा स्वयमेव व्यवस्थिता ..
यस्यां स्नातः पुमान्सद्यः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 6 ..
5.42.m: Where Gaṅgā, the river of the gods, resides of her own accord; / a man bathed in which is instantly freed from all sins.

5.42.s:
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya bhāvitaḥ ..
tadakṣayaṃ bhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptikārakam .. 7 ..
5.42.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं पितॄनुद्दिश्य भावितः ..
तदक्षयं भवेच्छ्राद्धं पितॄणां तृप्तिकारकम् .. 7 ..
5.42.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there dedicated to the ancestors with focused mind, / that śrāddha becomes imperishable, satisfying the ancestors.

5.42.s:
yatkiṃciddīyata dānaṃ tasmiṃstīrthavare dvijāḥ ..
hutajapyādikaṃ caiva tadanaṃtaphalaṃ bhavet .. 8 ..
5.42.d:
यत्किंचिद्दीयत दानं तस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे द्विजाः ..
हुतजप्यादिकं चैव तदनंतफलं भवेत् .. 8 ..
5.42.m: Whatever gift is given at that excellent sacred ford, O brahmins, / or oblation offered, recitation made, and so on, it brings endless fruit.

5.42.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya mṛgī vyādhaśarāhatā ..
praviṣṭā salile tasmiṃstatra pañcatvamāgatā .. 9 ..
5.42.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य मृगी व्याधशराहता ..
प्रविष्टा सलिले तस्मिंस्तत्र पञ्चत्वमागता .. 9 ..
5.42.m: Then, after some time, a female deer pierced by a hunter's arrow / entered that water and there met her death,

5.42.s:
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ madhyāhne dvijasattamāḥ ..
nakṣatre yamadaivatye mārtaṃḍasya ca vāsare .. 6.42.10 ..
5.42.d:
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां मध्याह्ने द्विजसत्तमाः ..
नक्षत्रे यमदैवत्ये मार्तंडस्य च वासरे .. 6.42.10 ..
5.42.m: On the third day of the bright fortnight of Caitra at midday, O foremost of brahmins, / under the asterism ruled by Yama and on the day of the sun.

5.42.s:
atha tattoyamāhātmyānmenakānāma sā'bhavat ..
apsarāstridaśeṃdrasya samaṃtāccāruhāsinī .. 11 ..
5.42.d:
अथ तत्तोयमाहात्म्यान्मेनकानाम साऽभवत् ..
अप्सरास्त्रिदशेंद्रस्य समंताच्चारुहासिनी .. 11 ..
5.42.m: Then, by the majesty of that water, she became an apsaras of the king of gods / named Menakā, possessing a charming smile all around.

5.42.s:
smaramāṇā'tha sā tasya prabhāvaṃ varavarṇinī ..
tīrthamāgatya sadbhaktyā snānaṃ tatra samācarat ..
caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yāmarkṣe sūryavāsare .. 12 ..
5.42.d:
स्मरमाणाऽथ सा तस्य प्रभावं वरवर्णिनी ..
तीर्थमागत्य सद्भक्त्या स्नानं तत्र समाचरत् ..
चैत्रशुक्लतृतीयायां यामर्क्षे सूर्यवासरे .. 12 ..
5.42.m: Recalling its power, that fair-complexioned one / came to the sacred ford and bathed there with true devotion / on the third day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, under the asterism of Yama on a Sunday.

5.42.s:
ekadā divase tasminbhramamāṇo munīśvaraḥ ..
viśvāmitra iti khyātastatrāyātastapo'nvitaḥ .. 13 ..
5.42.d:
एकदा दिवसे तस्मिन्भ्रममाणो मुनीश्वरः ..
विश्वामित्र इति ख्यातस्तत्रायातस्तपोऽन्वितः .. 13 ..
5.42.m: Once on that day, the lord of sages, / known as Viśvāmitra, endowed with austerity, wandering about, arrived there.

5.42.s:
sā'pi svargātsamāyātā devatādarśanārthataḥ ..
pūjayitvātha taṃ devaṃ prasthitā tridivaṃ prati .. 14 ..
5.42.d:
साऽपि स्वर्गात्समायाता देवतादर्शनार्थतः ..
पूजयित्वाथ तं देवं प्रस्थिता त्रिदिवं प्रति .. 14 ..
5.42.m: She too had arrived from heaven to behold the deity; / having worshipped that god, she was setting out for heaven.

5.42.s:
sā dṛṣṭvā taṃ muniṃ tatra bhramamāṇamitastataḥ ..
yauvanasthaṃ surūpāḍhyaṃ paṃcabāṇamivāparam.. 15 ..
5.42.d:
सा दृष्ट्वा तं मुनिं तत्र भ्रममाणमितस्ततः ..
यौवनस्थं सुरूपाढ्यं पंचबाणमिवापरम्.. 15 ..
5.42.m: Seeing that sage wandering here and there, / in the prime of youth, richly endowed with handsome form, like another Five-arrowed God,

5.42.s:
vrataprabhāvajairvyāptaṃ tejobhirbhāskaraṃ yathā ..
bālyātprabhṛti cīrṇena tapasā dagdhakilbiṣam.. 16 ..
5.42.d:
व्रतप्रभावजैर्व्याप्तं तेजोभिर्भास्करं यथा ..
बाल्यात्प्रभृति चीर्णेन तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषम्.. 16 ..
5.42.m: Pervaded by splendors born of the power of his vows like the sun, / his sins burned away by austerity practiced since childhood,

5.42.s:
sā tasya darśanādeva kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā ..
sānaṃdāḥ suratārthāya samīpaṃ samupādravat .. 17 ..
5.42.d:
सा तस्य दर्शनादेव कामबाणप्रपीडिता ..
सानंदाः सुरतार्थाय समीपं समुपाद्रवत् .. 17 ..
5.42.m: Afflicted by the arrows of Kāma from the mere sight of him, / she rushed to his side with joy for the sake of sexual union.

5.42.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā'dṛṣṭapūrvāṃ tāṃ mārgapṛcchākṛte tataḥ ..
sammukhaḥ prayayau tūrṇaṃ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā .. 18 ..
5.42.d:
स दृष्ट्वाऽदृष्टपूर्वां तां मार्गपृच्छाकृते ततः ..
सम्मुखः प्रययौ तूर्णं प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना .. 18 ..
5.42.m: Seeing her whom he had never seen before, he quickly went / toward her with a delighted inner self in order to ask the way.

5.42.s:
uvāca deśaṃ tāṃ pṛcchanstrīdharmāṃśca viśeṣataḥ ..
śubhalābho'stu te bhadre manasā karmaṇā girā .. 19 ..
5.42.d:
उवाच देशं तां पृच्छन्स्त्रीधर्मांश्च विशेषतः ..
शुभलाभोऽस्तु ते भद्रे मनसा कर्मणा गिरा .. 19 ..
5.42.m: Inquiring about the region and particularly about the duties of women, he said: / "May good fortune come to you, O auspicious lady, in thought, deed, and word!

5.42.s:
sadaiva vāsudevasya bhaktiścāvyabhicāriṇī..
kaccittvaṃ vartase putri patipādaparāyaṇā ..
cāritravinayopetā sarvadā priyavādinī .. 6.42.20 ..
5.42.d:
सदैव वासुदेवस्य भक्तिश्चाव्यभिचारिणी..
कच्चित्त्वं वर्तसे पुत्रि पतिपादपरायणा ..
चारित्रविनयोपेता सर्वदा प्रियवादिनी .. 6.42.20 ..
5.42.m: May your devotion to Vāsudeva always remain unswerving! / Do you dwell, my daughter, devoted to your husband's feet, / endowed with good conduct and modesty, and always speaking pleasantly?

5.42.s:
kaccittvaṃ sarvadābhīṣṭā patyurdānaistathārccanaiḥ ..
baṃdhūnsvamitravargaṃ ca tatpuraḥ pṛṣṭhatopi vā .. 21 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्त्वं सर्वदाभीष्टा पत्युर्दानैस्तथार्च्चनैः ..
बंधून्स्वमित्रवर्गं च तत्पुरः पृष्ठतोपि वा .. 21 ..
5.42.m: Are you always cherished by your husband through gifts and honors, / and do you respect your kinsmen and circle of friends before him or behind his back?

5.42.s:
kaccidbhartari saṃsupte tvaṃ niśavaśameṣyasi..
utthānamaprabuddhe ca karoṣi varavarṇini .. 22 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिद्भर्तरि संसुप्ते त्वं निशवशमेष्यसि..
उत्थानमप्रबुद्धे च करोषि वरवर्णिनि .. 22 ..
5.42.m: Do you succumb to sleep at night only when your husband has fallen asleep, / and do you arise before he awakens, O fair lady?

5.42.s:
kaccitprātaḥ samutthāya karoṣi gṛhamārjanam ..
svayameva varārohe maṇḍanaṃ copamaṇḍanam.. 23 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्प्रातः समुत्थाय करोषि गृहमार्जनम् ..
स्वयमेव वरारोहे मण्डनं चोपमण्डनम्.. 23 ..
5.42.m: Do you rise early in the morning and sweep the house / yourself, O lady of fair limbs, decorating and adorning it?

5.42.s:
kaccidevānnamaskṛtya guruṃ ca tadanaṃtaram ..
karoṣi tvaṃ prāṇayātrāṃ dattvānnaṃ śaktito jalam .. 24 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिदेवान्नमस्कृत्य गुरुं च तदनंतरम् ..
करोषि त्वं प्राणयात्रां दत्त्वान्नं शक्तितो जलम् .. 24 ..
5.42.m: Having bowed to the gods and next to your guru, / do you sustain your life after giving food and water according to your ability?

5.42.s:
kaccidastaṃgate sūrye nānnamaśnāsi bhābhini ..
adattvā vā svabhṛtyebhyaḥ sādhubhyaśca viśeṣataḥ .. 25 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिदस्तंगते सूर्ये नान्नमश्नासि भाभिनि ..
अदत्त्वा वा स्वभृत्येभ्यः साधुभ्यश्च विशेषतः .. 25 ..
5.42.m: Do you refrain from eating food after the sun has set, O radiant lady, / or without first offering it to your servants and especially to virtuous people?

5.42.s:
kaccitpibasi pānīyaṃ saptavāraviśodhitam [.
nibiḍena svavastreṇa pālayaṃtī jalodbhavān.. 26...
kacciddayāsamopetā gātrakleśakarānapi ..
yūkāmatkuṇadaṃśādīnputravatparirakṣasi.. 27 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्पिबसि पानीयं सप्तवारविशोधितम् [.
निबिडेन स्ववस्त्रेण पालयंती जलोद्भवान्.. 26...
कच्चिद्दयासमोपेता गात्रक्लेशकरानपि ..
यूकामत्कुणदंशादीन्पुत्रवत्परिरक्षसि.. 27 ..
5.42.m: Do you drink water purified seven times / through a dense cloth of your own, protecting the creatures born of water? / Endowed with compassion, do you protect like sons / lice, bedbugs, gnats, and others, even though they cause bodily distress?"

5.42.s:
kaccitsādhumukhānnityaṃ śivadharmaṃ subhaktitaḥ ..
śṛṇoṣi bhaktito bhadre prakaroṣi ca sādaram .. 28 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्साधुमुखान्नित्यं शिवधर्मं सुभक्तितः ..
शृणोषि भक्तितो भद्रे प्रकरोषि च सादरम् .. 28 ..
5.42.m: Do you always listen from the mouth of the virtuous, with excellent devotion, / to the law of Śiva, O auspicious lady, and practice it with devotion and respect? // 28

5.42.s:
kvacicchrutvā''gamaṃ puṇyaṃ prakaroṣi ca pūjanam..
śāstrasya vācakasyāpi vyākhyātuśca viśeṣataḥ .. 29 ..
5.42.d:
क्वचिच्छ्रुत्वा'ऽगमं पुण्यं प्रकरोषि च पूजनम्..
शास्त्रस्य वाचकस्यापि व्याख्यातुश्च विशेषतः .. 29 ..
5.42.m: Having heard the sacred Āgama somewhere, do you perform worship / of the scripture, and also especially of the reciter and the commentator? // 29

5.42.s:
kaccitpurāṇaśāstrāṇi praṇītāni janeśvaraiḥ ..
saṃlekhyākṣararamyāṇi sādhubhyaḥ saṃprayacchasi .. 6.42.30 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्पुराणशास्त्राणि प्रणीतानि जनेश्वरैः ..
संलेख्याक्षररम्याणि साधुभ्यः संप्रयच्छसि .. 6.42.30 ..
5.42.m: Do you present to the virtuous the Purāṇa scriptures composed by the lords of men, / which have been transcribed with beautiful letters? // 30

5.42.s:
yaḥ śrutvā sarva śāstrāṇi niṣkrayaṃ na prayacchati ..
śāstracauraḥ sa vijñeyo na caivāpnoti tatphalam .. 31 ..
5.42.d:
यः श्रुत्वा सर्व शास्त्राणि निष्क्रयं न प्रयच्छति ..
शास्त्रचौरः स विज्ञेयो न चैवाप्नोति तत्फलम् .. 31 ..
5.42.m: He who, having heard all the scriptures, does not give remuneration, / should be known as a scripture-thief, and indeed he does not attain its fruit. // 31

5.42.s:
kaccicchivālaye nṛtyagītavādyādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
balipūjopahārāṃśca tvaṃ karoṣi ca śaktitaḥ .. 32 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिच्छिवालये नृत्यगीतवाद्यादिकाः क्रियाः ..
बलिपूजोपहारांश्च त्वं करोषि च शक्तितः .. 32 ..
5.42.m: Do you perform rituals such as dance, song, and instrumental music, / along with offerings of bali, worship, and presents, according to your ability in the temple of Śiva? // 32

5.42.s:
kaccitprāvaraṇaṃ vastraṃ subhage sarvameva ca ..
saṃprayacchasi sādhubhyaḥ praṇipātapuraḥsaram .. 33 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्प्रावरणं वस्त्रं सुभगे सर्वमेव च ..
संप्रयच्छसि साधुभ्यः प्रणिपातपुरःसरम् .. 33 ..
5.42.m: Do you bestow upon the virtuous, O blessed lady, all garments and coverings / preceded by prostration? // 33

5.42.s:
vṛthā paryaṭanaṃ nityaṃ kaccinna paramaṃdire ..
tvaṃ karoṣi viśālākṣi viśeṣeṇa niśāgame .. 34 ..
5.42.d:
वृथा पर्यटनं नित्यं कच्चिन्न परमंदिरे ..
त्वं करोषि विशालाक्षि विशेषेण निशागमे .. 34 ..
5.42.m: Do you never wander about in vain in another's house constantly, / O large-eyed lady, especially when night arrives? // 34

5.42.s:
kaccinnāśnāsi bhadre tvaṃ svabhartari bubhukṣite ..
ājñābhaṃgaṃ prayatnena kaccittatra prarakṣasi .. 35 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिन्नाश्नासि भद्रे त्वं स्वभर्तरि बुभुक्षिते ..
आज्ञाभंगं प्रयत्नेन कच्चित्तत्र प्ररक्षसि .. 35 ..
5.42.m: Do you not eat, O auspicious lady, while your husband is hungry? / Do you assiduously guard against disobeying his command in that matter? // 35

5.42.s:
kaccitprakupite kāṃte nottarāṇi prayacchasi ..
tasyakopapraṇāśārṣaṃ priyaṃ kaccicca jalpasi .. 36 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्प्रकुपिते कांते नोत्तराणि प्रयच्छसि ..
तस्यकोपप्रणाशार्षं प्रियं कच्चिच्च जल्पसि .. 36 ..
5.42.m: When your beloved is enraged, do you refrain from retorting? / And do you speak pleasantly to extinguish his anger? // 36

5.42.s:
kaccittvaṃ proṣite kāṃte malināṃbaradhāriṇī ..
jāyase ca tathā dīnā vivarṇavadanā kṛśā .. 37 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चित्त्वं प्रोषिते कांते मलिनांबरधारिणी ..
जायसे च तथा दीना विवर्णवदना कृशा .. 37 ..
5.42.m: When your beloved is away on a journey, do you wear soiled garments / and become dejected, pale-faced, and thin? // 37

5.42.s:
kaccinmaṃdirapṛṣṭhe tvaṃ na dhatse bhinnabhājanam ..
ucchiṣṭaṃ vā janaistyaktamapi kāryopakārakam .. 39 ..
kaccidvrajasi no rātrau jāgareṣu kathāsu ca ..
nirjhareṣu vivikteṣu pulineṣu vaneṣu ca .. 39 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिन्मंदिरपृष्ठे त्वं न धत्से भिन्नभाजनम् ..
उच्छिष्टं वा जनैस्त्यक्तमपि कार्योपकारकम् .. 39 ..
कच्चिद्व्रजसि नो रात्रौ जागरेषु कथासु च ..
निर्झरेषु विविक्तेषु पुलिनेषु वनेषु च .. 39 ..
5.42.m:
Do you not keep a broken vessel on the roof of the house, / or food remnants discarded by people, even if useful for a purpose? // 38
Do you not go out at night to vigils and story-tellings, / or to streams, secluded places, sandbanks, and woods? // 39

5.42.s:
kaccinna kuruṣe maitrīṃ baṃdhakībhiḥ samaṃ śubhe ..
dhātrībhirmālikastrībhī rajakībhiśca bhāmini .. 6.42.40 ..
5.42.d:
कच्चिन्न कुरुषे मैत्रीं बंधकीभिः समं शुभे ..
धात्रीभिर्मालिकस्त्रीभी रजकीभिश्च भामिनि .. 6.42.40 ..
5.42.m: Do you not make friendship with unchaste women, O fair one, / or with wet-nurses, gardeners' wives, and washerwomen, O spirited woman? // 40

5.42.s:
kañciddadhāsi nityaṃ tvaṃ mukhaṃ kuṃkumaraṃjitam ..
śiraḥ puṣpasamākīrṇaṃ netre kajjalaraṃjite .. 41 ..
5.42.d:
कञ्चिद्दधासि नित्यं त्वं मुखं कुंकुमरंजितम् ..
शिरः पुष्पसमाकीर्णं नेत्रे कज्जलरंजिते .. 41 ..
5.42.m: Do you always keep your face adorned with saffron, / your head strewn with flowers, and your eyes adorned with collyrium? // 41

5.42.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpattivṛttānte viśvāmitramenakāsamāgamavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo dhyāyaḥ .. 42 .. .. cha ..
5.42.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रकुण्डोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्ते विश्वामित्रमेनकासमागमवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशो ध्यायः .. 42 .. .. छ ..
5.42.m: Thus ends the forty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Union of Viśvāmitra and Menakā,' in the account of the origin of Viśvāmitrakuṇḍa, in the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. // 42

5.43.s:
.. menakovāca .. ..
anyāstā nāyikā vipra yāsāṃ dharmastvayoditaḥ ..
svecchācāravihāriṇyo vayaṃ veśyā divaukasām .. 1 ..
5.43.d:
.. मेनकोवाच .. ..
अन्यास्ता नायिका विप्र यासां धर्मस्त्वयोदितः ..
स्वेच्छाचारविहारिण्यो वयं वेश्या दिवौकसाम् .. 1 ..
5.43.m: Menakā said: / Other women are the mistresses, O brahmin, whose duty has been declared by you; / we are the courtesans of the gods, wandering according to our own desire. // 1

5.43.s:
sa tvaṃ vada mahābhāga kasmāddeśātsamāgataḥ ..
mama cittaharo vāpi tīrthe dharmiṣṭhasaṃśraye .. 2 ..
5.43.d:
स त्वं वद महाभाग कस्माद्देशात्समागतः ..
मम चित्तहरो वापि तीर्थे धर्मिष्ठसंश्रये .. 2 ..
5.43.m: Therefore tell me, O illustrious one: from what country have you arrived, / captivator of my heart, at this sacred ford which is the resort of the most righteous? // 2

5.43.s:
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvāhaṃ mahābhāga kāmadeva samākṛtim ..
pulakāṃcitasarvāṃgī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā .. 3 ..
5.43.d:
त्वां दृष्ट्वाहं महाभाग कामदेव समाकृतिम् ..
पुलकांचितसर्वांगी कामबाणप्रपीडिता .. 3 ..
5.43.m: Having seen you, O illustrious one, who have the form of the god of love, / with all my limbs bristling with excitement, I am tormented by the arrows of desire. // 3

5.43.s:
tasmādbhajasva māṃ raktāṃ no cedyāsyāmi saṃkṣayam ..
kāmabāṇapradagdhā vai puro'pi tava tāpasa ..
tataḥ strīvadhapāpena lipyase tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
5.43.d:
तस्माद्भजस्व मां रक्तां नो चेद्यास्यामि संक्षयम् ..
कामबाणप्रदग्धा वै पुरोऽपि तव तापस ..
ततः स्त्रीवधपापेन लिप्यसे त्वं न संशयः .. 4 ..
5.43.m: Therefore yield to me who am in love with you; otherwise I shall perish, / utterly burned by the arrows of desire, right before you, O ascetic! / Then you will be smeared with the sin of killing a woman, without doubt. // 4

5.43.s:
.. tāpasa uvāca .. ..
vayaṃ vratadharāḥ subhru brahmacaryaparāyaṇāḥ ..
mūrkhāḥ kāmavidhau bhadre niratāḥ śivaśāsane .. 5 ..
5.43.d:
.. तापस उवाच .. ..
वयं व्रतधराः सुभ्रु ब्रह्मचर्यपरायणाः ..
मूर्खाः कामविधौ भद्रे निरताः शिवशासने .. 5 ..
5.43.m: The ascetic said: / We are observers of vows, O fair-browed one, devoted to celibacy, / ignorant in the ways of sensual desire, O auspicious lady, and devoted to the ordinance of Śiva. // 5

5.43.s:
sarveṣāṃ vratināṃ mūlaṃ brahmacaryamudāhṛtam ..
viśeṣācchivabhaktānāmevaṃ bhūyo vidhāsyasi .. 6 ..
5.43.d:
सर्वेषां व्रतिनां मूलं ब्रह्मचर्यमुदाहृतम् ..
विशेषाच्छिवभक्तानामेवं भूयो विधास्यसि .. 6 ..
5.43.m: Celibacy is proclaimed to be the root of all vow-holders, / especially of the devotees of Śiva; thus you will act again. // 6

5.43.s:
api varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ yattapaḥ kurute vratī ..
sakṛtstrīsaṃgamānnāśaṃ yāti pāśupatasya ca .. 7 ..
5.43.d:
अपि वर्षशतं साग्रं यत्तपः कुरुते व्रती ..
सकृत्स्त्रीसंगमान्नाशं याति पाशुपतस्य च .. 7 ..
5.43.m: Even the austerity that an observer of vows performs for a full hundred years / goes to destruction from a single contact with a woman for a Pāśupata. // 7

5.43.s:
māṃ ca pāśupataṃ lubdhā kasmāttvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase ..
īdṛkpāpatamaṃ karma garhitaṃ śivaśāsane .. 8 ..
5.43.d:
मां च पाशुपतं लुब्धा कस्मात्त्वं भीरु भाषसे ..
ईदृक्पापतमं कर्म गर्हितं शिवशासने .. 8 ..
5.43.m: Why do you, lustful and timid, speak to me, a Pāśupata? / Such a most sinful act is condemned in the ordinance of Śiva. // 8

5.43.s:
yaḥ strīṃ bhajati pāpātmā vṛthā pāśupatavratī ..
so'tītāndaśa cādhāya puruṣānnarake pacet .. 9 ..
5.43.d:
यः स्त्रीं भजति पापात्मा वृथा पाशुपतव्रती ..
सोऽतीतान्दश चाधाय पुरुषान्नरके पचेत् .. 9 ..
5.43.m: That sinful soul who, observing the Pāśupata vow in vain, unites with a woman, / would roast in hell, taking ten preceding generations of men along with him. // 9

5.43.s:
āstāṃ tāvatsamā saṃgaṃ saṃsparśaṃ ca varānane ..
saṃbhāṣamapi pāpāya strībhiḥ pāśupatasya ca .. 6.43.10 ..
5.43.d:
आस्तां तावत्समा संगं संस्पर्शं च वरानने ..
संभाषमपि पापाय स्त्रीभिः पाशुपतस्य च .. 6.43.10 ..
5.43.m: Let alone close association and physical contact, O fair-faced one; / even conversation with women leads to sin for a Pāśupata. // 10

5.43.s:
tasmād drutataraṃ gaccha sthānādasmādvarāṃgane ..
yatrāvāpsyasi cābhīṣṭaṃ tatra tvaṃ gantumarhasi .. 11 ..
5.43.d:
तस्माद् द्रुततरं गच्छ स्थानादस्माद्वरांगने ..
यत्रावाप्स्यसि चाभीष्टं तत्र त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि .. 11 ..
5.43.m: Therefore go quickly from this place, O excellent woman; / you ought to go to that place where you will obtain your desire. // 11

5.43.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpattivṛttānte viśvāmitramenakāsaṃvādavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 43 .. .. cha ..
5.43.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रकुण्डोत्पत्तिवृत्तान्ते विश्वामित्रमेनकासंवादवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 43 .. .. छ ..
5.43.m: Thus ends the forty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Dialogue of Viśvāmitra and Menakā,' in the account of the origin of Viśvāmitrakuṇḍa, in the māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses. // 43

5.44.s:
.. menakovāca .. ..
nūnaṃ hi kāmadharme tvaṃ na pravīṇo mahādyute ..
tena māmīdṛśairvākyairnivārayasi rāgiṇīm .. 1 ..
5.44.d:
.. मेनकोवाच .. ..
नूनं हि कामधर्मे त्वं न प्रवीणो महाद्युते ..
तेन मामीदृशैर्वाक्यैर्निवारयसि रागिणीम् .. 1 ..
5.44.m: Menakā said: / Surely, O you of great splendor, you are not skilled in the ways of love; / for that reason, you ward me off, who am impassioned, with such words. // 1

5.44.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktastato bhūyo viśvāmitro'bravīdidam ..
kopena mahatā yukto niḥspṛhastatparigrahe .. 2 ..
5.44.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तस्ततो भूयो विश्वामित्रोऽब्रवीदिदम् ..
कोपेन महता युक्तो निःस्पृहस्तत्परिग्रहे .. 2 ..
5.44.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed, Viśvāmitra then spoke this again, / filled with great anger, having no desire to accept her. // 2

5.44.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
tvaṃ jīva gaccha vā mṛtyuṃ nāhaṃ kartāsmi te vacaḥ ..
vratanāśāttu yatpāpamadhikaṃ strīvadhādbhavet .. 3 ..
5.44.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
त्वं जीव गच्छ वा मृत्युं नाहं कर्तास्मि ते वचः ..
व्रतनाशात्तु यत्पापमधिकं स्त्रीवधाद्भवेत् .. 3 ..
5.44.m: Viśvāmitra said: / Either live or go to death; I will not do your bidding! / For greater is the sin that arises from the destruction of a vow than from killing a woman. // 3

5.44.s:
prāyaścittaṃ budhairuktaṃ vratināṃ strīvadhe kṛte ..
na saṃgāttu punastāsāṃ tasmāttvaṃ gantumarhasi .. 4 ..
5.44.d:
प्रायश्चित्तं बुधैरुक्तं व्रतिनां स्त्रीवधे कृते ..
न संगात्तु पुनस्तासां तस्मात्त्वं गन्तुमर्हसि .. 4 ..
5.44.m: An expiation has been declared by the wise for observers of vows when the killing of a woman is committed, / but none for contact with them; therefore you should depart. // 4

5.44.s:
na kevalaṃ vratopetāḥ strīsaṃgātpāpamāpnuyuḥ ..
vratabāhyā api narāḥ saktāḥ strīṣu pataṃtyadhaḥ .. 5 ..
5.44.d:
न केवलं व्रतोपेताः स्त्रीसंगात्पापमाप्नुयुः ..
व्रतबाह्या अपि नराः सक्ताः स्त्रीषु पतंत्यधः .. 5 ..
5.44.m: Not only do those engaged in vows incur sin from contact with women; / even men devoid of vows, when attached to women, fall low. // 5

5.44.s:
saṃsārabhramaṇaṃ nārī prathamepi samāgame ..
vahnipradakṣiṇā vyājanyāyenaiva pradarśayet .. 6 ..
5.44.d:
संसारभ्रमणं नारी प्रथमेपि समागमे ..
वह्निप्रदक्षिणा व्याजन्यायेनैव प्रदर्शयेत् .. 6 ..
5.44.m: A woman reveals the wandering of worldly existence even at the very first union, / by the very pretext of circumambulating the fire. // 6

5.44.s:
tasmātstrībhiḥ samaṃ prājñaḥ saṃbhāṣāmapi varjayet ..
āstāṃ tāvatsamāsaṃgaṃ ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ ..7 ..
5.44.d:
तस्मात्स्त्रीभिः समं प्राज्ञः संभाषामपि वर्जयेत् ..
आस्तां तावत्समासंगं य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः ..7 ..
5.44.m: Therefore, a wise man should avoid even conversation with women, / let alone intimate union, if he desires his own welfare. // 7

5.44.s:
aṃgāra sadṛśā nārī ghṛtakuṃbhasamaḥ pumān ..
asparśāddṛḍhatāmeti tatsaṃparkādvilīyate .. 8 ..
5.44.d:
अंगार सदृशा नारी घृतकुंभसमः पुमान् ..
अस्पर्शाद्दृढतामेति तत्संपर्काद्विलीयते .. 8 ..
5.44.m: A woman is like a glowing coal, and a man is like a jar of clarified butter: / without contact he attains firmness; upon contact with her, he melts away. // 8

5.44.s:
striyo mūlamanarthānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi ..
tasmāttyājyā sudūreṇa tāḥ svargasya nirodhakāḥ .. 9 ..
5.44.d:
स्त्रियो मूलमनर्थानां सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भुवि ..
तस्मात्त्याज्या सुदूरेण ताः स्वर्गस्य निरोधकाः .. 9 ..
5.44.m: Women are the root of all misfortunes for all living beings on earth; / therefore, they should be abandoned far away, being obstacles to heaven. // 9

5.44.s:
kulīnā vittavatyaśca nāthavatyo'pi yoṣitaḥ ..
ekasminnaṃtare rāgaṃ kurvaṃtyetāḥ sucañcalāḥ ..6.44.10..
5.44.d:
कुलीना वित्तवत्यश्च नाथवत्योऽपि योषितः ..
एकस्मिन्नंतरे रागं कुर्वंत्येताः सुचञ्चलाः ..6.44.10..
5.44.m: Even women of noble birth, wealthy, and having husbands, / being extremely fickle, set their passion elsewhere in an instant. // 10

5.44.s:
na strībhyaḥ kiṃcidanyaddhi pāpāya vidyate bhuvi ..
yāsāṃ saṃgasamāsādya saṃsāre bhramate janaḥ ......
nīco'pi kurute sevāṃ yastāsāṃ vijaneṣvatha ..
virūpaṃ vāpi nīcaṃ vā taṃ sevante hi tāḥ striyaḥ .. 12 ..
5.44.d:
न स्त्रीभ्यः किंचिदन्यद्धि पापाय विद्यते भुवि ..
यासां संगसमासाद्य संसारे भ्रमते जनः ......
नीचोऽपि कुरुते सेवां यस्तासां विजनेष्वथ ..
विरूपं वापि नीचं वा तं सेवन्ते हि ताः स्त्रियः .. 12 ..
5.44.m: For there exists nothing else on earth that leads to sin more than women, / having obtained whose contact people wander in worldly existence. / Even a base man who serves them in secret— / women attend upon him, whether he is deformed or low-born. // 11-12

5.44.s:
anarthatvānmanuṣyāṇāṃ bhayātparijanasya ca ..
maryādāyāmamaryādāḥ striyastiṣṭhanti bhartṛṣu .. 13 ..
5.44.d:
अनर्थत्वान्मनुष्याणां भयात्परिजनस्य च ..
मर्यादायाममर्यादाः स्त्रियस्तिष्ठन्ति भर्तृषु .. 13 ..
5.44.m: Due to the worthlessness of men and fear of their attendants, / unruly women stay within the bounds of propriety toward their husbands. // 13

5.44.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saṃbhartsitā tena menakā kopasaṃyutā ..
śaśāpa taṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ sphuramāṇoṣṭhasaṃpuṭā .. 14 ..
5.44.d:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं संभर्त्सिता तेन मेनका कोपसंयुता ..
शशाप तं मुनिश्रेष्ठं स्फुरमाणोष्ठसंपुटा .. 14 ..
5.44.m: Sūta said: / Thus rebuked by him, Menakā, filled with anger, / cursed that best of sages with trembling lips: 14

5.44.s:
yasmāttvayā parityaktā sakāmāhaṃ sudurmate..
tyajatā kāmajaṃ dharmaṃ tasmācchāpaṃ gṛhāṇa me .. 15 ..
5.44.d:
यस्मात्त्वया परित्यक्ता सकामाहं सुदुर्मते..
त्यजता कामजं धर्मं तस्माच्छापं गृहाण मे .. 15 ..
5.44.m: “Since I, filled with desire, have been abandoned by you, O extremely evil-minded one, / abandoning the duty born of desire, therefore accept my curse! 15

5.44.s:
adyaiva bhava duburddhe valīpalitasaṃyutaḥ ..
jarājarjjaritāṃgaśca tucchadṛṣṭirviraṃgitaḥ .. 16 ..
5.44.d:
अद्यैव भव दुबुर्द्धे वलीपलितसंयुतः ..
जराजर्ज्जरितांगश्च तुच्छदृष्टिर्विरंगितः .. 16 ..
5.44.m: This very day, O fool, become covered with wrinkles and grey hair, / with limbs worn out by old age, your eyesight diminished, and bent crooked!” 16

5.44.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
uktamātre tu vacane tatkṣaṇānmunisattamaḥ ..
babhūva tādṛśaḥ sadyastayā yādṛkprakīrtitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.44.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
उक्तमात्रे तु वचने तत्क्षणान्मुनिसत्तमः ..
बभूव तादृशः सद्यस्तया यादृक्प्रकीर्तितः .. 17 ..
5.44.m: Sūta said: / The moment the word was spoken, instantly the best of sages / became just as she had described. 17

5.44.s:
tataḥ kopaparītātmā so'pi tāṃ śaptumudyataḥ ..
kamaṇḍalorjalaṃ gṛhya saṃtāpādraktalocanaḥ .. 18 ..
5.44.d:
ततः कोपपरीतात्मा सोऽपि तां शप्तुमुद्यतः ..
कमण्डलोर्जलं गृह्य संतापाद्रक्तलोचनः .. 18 ..
5.44.m: Then, his mind overcome with rage, he too prepared to curse her; / taking water from his water-pot, his eyes red with anger, [he said:] 18

5.44.s:
nirdoṣo'pi tvayā yasmācchapto'haṃ gaṇikādhame ..
tasmādbhava tvamapyāśu jarājarjaritāṃgikā .. 19 ..
5.44.d:
निर्दोषोऽपि त्वया यस्माच्छप्तोऽहं गणिकाधमे ..
तस्माद्भव त्वमप्याशु जराजर्जरितांगिका .. 19 ..
5.44.m: “Because I, though faultless, was cursed by you, O lowest of courtesans, / therefore do you also quickly become worn out in your limbs with old age!” 19

5.44.s:
sāpi tadvacanātsadyastādṛgrūpā vyajāyata ..
yādṛśo'sau muniśreṣṭho valīpalitagātrabhṛt .. 6.44.20 ..
5.44.d:
सापि तद्वचनात्सद्यस्तादृग्रूपा व्यजायत ..
यादृशोऽसौ मुनिश्रेष्ठो वलीपलितगात्रभृत् .. 6.44.20 ..
5.44.m: She too, by his word, instantly took on such a form / as that best of sages, bearing a body with wrinkles and grey hair. 20

5.44.s:
atha tādṛksvarūpeṇa snātā tatra jalā śaye ..
bhūyo'pi tādṛśī jātā yādṛśī saṃsthitā purā .. 21 ..
5.44.d:
अथ तादृक्स्वरूपेण स्नाता तत्र जला शये ..
भूयोऽपि तादृशी जाता यादृशी संस्थिता पुरा .. 21 ..
5.44.m: Then, having bathed in that reservoir in such a form, / she again became just as she had been before. 21

5.44.s:
taddṛṣṭvā paramāścaryamatīva tvarayānvitaḥ..
so'pi tatrākarotsnānaṃ saṃjātaśca yathā purā .. 22 ..
5.44.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा परमाश्चर्यमतीव त्वरयान्वितः..
सोऽपि तत्राकरोत्स्नानं संजातश्च यथा पुरा .. 22 ..
5.44.m: Seeing that supreme wonder, filled with great haste, / he too took a ritual ablution there and became as [he was] before. 22

5.44.s:
tatastau tīrthamāhātmyādrūpaudāryaguṇānvitau ..
mitha āmaṃtrya saṃhṛṣṭau gatau deśaṃ yathepsitam .. 23 ..
5.44.d:
ततस्तौ तीर्थमाहात्म्याद्रूपौदार्यगुणान्वितौ ..
मिथ आमंत्र्य संहृष्टौ गतौ देशं यथेप्सितम् .. 23 ..
5.44.m: Then the two of them, endowed with the qualities of beauty and nobility through the māhātmya of the sacred ford, / took leave of each other delighted and went to the place each desired. 23

5.44.s:
evaṃ tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ vijñāya bhagavānṛṣiḥ ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ .. 24 ..
5.44.d:
एवं तीर्थस्य माहात्म्यं विज्ञाय भगवानृषिः ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामास देवदेवस्य शूलिनः .. 24 ..
5.44.m: Having thus understood the māhātmya of the sacred ford, the venerable ṛṣi / installed a liṅga of the trident-bearing God of gods. 24

5.44.s:
tapaścakāra sumahattasmiṃstīrthavare tadā ..
kuśastambena kṛtavāṃstatsaro vipulaṃ vibhuḥ .. .. 25 ..
5.44.d:
तपश्चकार सुमहत्तस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे तदा ..
कुशस्तम्बेन कृतवांस्तत्सरो विपुलं विभुः .. .. 25 ..
5.44.m: He then performed great austerity at that best of sacred fords; / with a clump of kuśa grass the lord created that vast lake. 25

5.44.s:
tatra snātvā naro yastu pūjayelliṃgamuttamam ..
viśvāmitreśvaraṃ khyātaṃ sa gacchecchivamaṃdiram .. 26 ..
5.44.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो यस्तु पूजयेल्लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
विश्वामित्रेश्वरं ख्यातं स गच्छेच्छिवमंदिरम् .. 26 ..
5.44.m: A person who, having bathed there, worships that excellent liṅga, / known as Viśvāmitreśvara, goes to the abode of Śiva. 26

5.44.s:
adyāpi dṛśyate tatra gaṃgodakasamaṃ jalam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvakāmapradāyakam .. 27 ..
5.44.d:
अद्यापि दृश्यते तत्र गंगोदकसमं जलम् ..
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं सर्वकामप्रदायकम् .. 27 ..
5.44.m: Even today the water seen there is equal to the water of the Gaṅgā, / removing all sins, holy, and granting all desires. 27

5.44.s:
yastatra kurute snānaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
sa devalokamāsādya pitṛbhiḥ saha modate ..28..
5.44.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानं श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
स देवलोकमासाद्य पितृभिः सह मोदते ..28..
5.44.m: Whoever performs a ritual ablution there with a mind purified by faith / reaches the world of the gods and rejoices with the ancestors. 28

5.44.s:
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātiṃ prāptaṃ mahītale ..
pātāle svargaloke ca rūpaudāryapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 29 ..
5.44.d:
ततःप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं ख्यातिं प्राप्तं महीतले ..
पाताले स्वर्गलोके च रूपौदार्यप्रदं नृणाम् .. 29 ..
5.44.m: From that time forth, that sacred ford attained fame on the earth, / in Pātāla, and in the heavenly realm, as bestowing beauty and nobility upon mortals. 29

5.44.s:
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭo'smi dvijottamāḥ ..
viśvāmitreśa māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 6.44.30 ..
5.44.d:
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टोऽस्मि द्विजोत्तमाः ..
विश्वामित्रेश माहात्म्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 6.44.30 ..
5.44.m: All this has been related to you about which I was asked, O best of the twice-born: / the māhātmya of Viśvāmitreśa, which destroys all sins. 30

5.44.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakevarakṣetramāhātmye viśvāmitrakuṇḍotpatti viśvāmitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 44 .. ..
5.44.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे श्रीहाटकेवरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विश्वामित्रकुण्डोत्पत्ति विश्वामित्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 44 .. ..
5.44.m: Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Origin of Viśvāmitrakuṇḍa and the Description of the Māhātmya of Viśvāmitreśvara,” in the māhātmya of the sacred field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section] in the venerable Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 44

5.45.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatraivāsti dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamānartādhipabhūbhujā .. 1 ..
5.45.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रैवास्ति द्विजश्रेष्ठाः सुपुण्यं पुष्करत्रयम्..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तमानर्ताधिपभूभुजा .. 1 ..
5.45.m: Sūta said: / Right there, O best of the twice-born, is the exceedingly holy triad of Puṣkaras, / where austerity was performed of old by the king who ruled Ānarta. 1

5.45.s:
yastatra kārtike māsi kṛttikāsthe niśākare ..
madhyāhne kurute snānaṃ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim .. 2 ..
5.45.d:
यस्तत्र कार्तिके मासि कृत्तिकास्थे निशाकरे ..
मध्याह्ने कुरुते स्नानं स गच्छति परां गतिम् .. 2 ..
5.45.m: Whoever performs a ritual ablution there at midday in the month of Kārttika / when the moon is in Kṛttikā, goes to the supreme state. 2

5.45.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ tatra samāyātaṃ supuṇyaṃ puṣkaratrayam ..
kasminsthāne ca vijñeyaṃ kaiścihnairvada sūtaja .. .. 3 ..
5.45.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं तत्र समायातं सुपुण्यं पुष्करत्रयम् ..
कस्मिन्स्थाने च विज्ञेयं कैश्चिह्नैर्वद सूतज .. .. 3 ..
5.45.m: The ṛṣis said: / How did the exceedingly holy triad of Puṣkaras arrive there? / And in what place is it to be recognized, and by what signs? Tell us, O Sūta! 3

5.45.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi yaiścihnaiḥ puṣkaratrayam ..
prāgdṛṣṭaṃ muninā tatra viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā .. 4 ..
5.45.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अहं वः कीर्तयिष्यामि यैश्चिह्नैः पुष्करत्रयम् ..
प्राग्दृष्टं मुनिना तत्र विश्वामित्रेण धीमता .. 4 ..
5.45.m: Sūta said: / I shall declare to you by what signs the triad of Puṣkaras / was seen of old there by the sage, the wise Viśvāmitra. 4

5.45.s:
purā nivasatastasya viśvāmitrasya sanmuneḥ ..
saṃprāptā kārtikī puṇyā kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā .. 5 ..
5.45.d:
पुरा निवसतस्तस्य विश्वामित्रस्य सन्मुनेः ..
संप्राप्ता कार्तिकी पुण्या कृत्तिकायोगसंयुता .. 5 ..
5.45.m: Anciently, while that good sage Viśvāmitra was dwelling there, / the holy full-moon day of Kārttika, joined with the asterism Kṛttikā, arrived. 5

5.45.s:
sarvatīrthamayaṃ kṣetraṃ tadvijñāya taponidhiḥ ..
tataśca cintayāmāsa svacitte gādhinandanaḥ .. 6 ..
5.45.d:
सर्वतीर्थमयं क्षेत्रं तद्विज्ञाय तपोनिधिः ..
ततश्च चिन्तयामास स्वचित्ते गाधिनन्दनः .. 6 ..
5.45.m: Knowing that sacred field to consist of all sacred fords, the treasury of austerity, / that son of Gādhi, then pondered in his own mind: 6

5.45.s:
adyeyaṃ kārtikī puṇyā kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā ..
yasyāṃ snāne naraiḥ śreyaḥ prāpyate puṣkarodake ..
ādyaṃ tu puṣkaraṃ dūre na gantuṃ śakyate'dhunā .. 7 ..
5.45.d:
अद्येयं कार्तिकी पुण्या कृत्तिकायोगसंयुता ..
यस्यां स्नाने नरैः श्रेयः प्राप्यते पुष्करोदके ..
आद्यं तु पुष्करं दूरे न गन्तुं शक्यतेऽधुना .. 7 ..
5.45.m: “Today is that holy full-moon day of Kārttika, joined with the asterism Kṛttikā, / on which welfare is obtained by men through bathing in the water of Puṣkara; / but the original Puṣkara is far away, and it is impossible to go now. 7

5.45.s:
tasmādatra sthitaṃ yacca tasminsnānaṃ karomyaham ..
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 8 ..
5.45.d:
तस्मादत्र स्थितं यच्च तस्मिन्स्नानं करोम्यहम् ..
स एवं निश्चयं कृत्वा श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 8 ..
5.45.m: Therefore I shall perform my ritual ablution in whatever is located here.” / Having thus resolved with a mind purified by faith, 8

5.45.s:
tataścānveṣayāmāsa puṣkarāṇi samaṃtataḥ ..
bahutvāttatra tīrthānāṃ niścayaṃ nānvapadyata ..9..
5.45.d:
ततश्चान्वेषयामास पुष्कराणि समंततः ..
बहुत्वात्तत्र तीर्थानां निश्चयं नान्वपद्यत ..9..
5.45.m: he then searched for the Puṣkaras on every side; / but because of the multitude of sacred fords there, he could not reach a certainty. 9

5.45.s:
dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā jalasthānaṃ snānaṃ cakre tataḥ param..
sa tadā śramamāpanno bhramamāṇa itastataḥ..6.45.10..
5.45.d:
दृष्ट्वादृष्ट्वा जलस्थानं स्नानं चक्रे ततः परम्..
स तदा श्रममापन्नो भ्रममाण इतस्ततः..6.45.10..
5.45.m: Looking repeatedly at every body of water, he performed his ritual ablution after that; / then, wandering here and there, he became exhausted. 10

5.45.s:
vṛkṣamūlaṃ samāśritya niviṣṭaśca kṣitau tataḥ..
tuṣṭāvātha śucirbhūtvā śraddhayā ca tripuṣkaram ......
madhyamādyojanaṃ svargaḥ kaniṣṭhādardha yojanam ..
jyeṣṭhakuṇḍātpunaḥ khyāto hastaprāyaḥ śubhātmabhiḥ .. 12 ..
5.45.d:
वृक्षमूलं समाश्रित्य निविष्टश्च क्षितौ ततः..
तुष्टावाथ शुचिर्भूत्वा श्रद्धया च त्रिपुष्करम् ......
मध्यमाद्योजनं स्वर्गः कनिष्ठादर्ध योजनम् ..
ज्येष्ठकुण्डात्पुनः ख्यातो हस्तप्रायः शुभात्मभिः .. 12 ..
5.45.m: Having resorted to the root of a tree, he sat down upon the ground; / then, having become pure, he praised the three Puṣkaras with faith: / “Heaven is a yojana from the Middle one, half a yojana from the Smallest, / while from the Eldest pool it is declared by the pure-minded to be nearly a cubit away. 12

5.45.s:
pāvayaṃti hi tīrthāni snānadānādasaṃśayam ..
puṣkarālokanādeva naraḥ pāpātpramu cyate .. 13 ..
5.45.d:
पावयंति हि तीर्थानि स्नानदानादसंशयम् ..
पुष्करालोकनादेव नरः पापात्प्रमु च्यते .. 13 ..
5.45.m: The sacred fords certainly purify through bathing and gifts; / but by the mere sight of Puṣkara a person is freed from sin. 13

5.45.s:
puṣkarāraṇyamāśritya śākamūlaphalairapi ..
ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā .. 14 ..
5.45.d:
पुष्करारण्यमाश्रित्य शाकमूलफलैरपि ..
एकस्मिन्भोजिते विप्रे कोटिर्भवति भोजिता .. 14 ..
5.45.m: Resorting to the forest of Puṣkara, if a single brahmin is fed / even with greens, roots, and fruits, ten million are fed! 14

5.45.s:
puṣkare duṣkaraṃ snānaṃ puṣkare duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ ..
puṣkare duṣkaro vāsaḥ sarvaṃ puṣkaraduṣkaram .. 15 ..
5.45.d:
पुष्करे दुष्करं स्नानं पुष्करे दुष्करं तपः ..
पुष्करे दुष्करो वासः सर्वं पुष्करदुष्करम् .. 15 ..
5.45.m: Difficult is ritual ablution at Puṣkara, difficult is austerity at Puṣkara, / difficult is dwelling at Puṣkara; everything is difficult at Puṣkara! 15

5.45.s:
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge puṣkare snāti yo naraḥ ..
sa kṣaṇānmucyate pāpādājanmamaraṇodbhavāt .. 16 ..
5.45.d:
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे पुष्करे स्नाति यो नरः ..
स क्षणान्मुच्यते पापादाजन्ममरणोद्भवात् .. 16 ..
5.45.m: The person who bathes at Puṣkara on the full-moon day of Kārttika under the asterism Kṛttikā / is instantly freed from the sin arising from birth and death! 16

5.45.s:
jyeṣṭhe prātaśca madhyāhne madhyame snāti yo naraḥ ..
kaniṣṭhe'stamite bhānau sakṛtsvargamavāpnuyāt .. 17 ..
5.45.d:
ज्येष्ठे प्रातश्च मध्याह्ने मध्यमे स्नाति यो नरः ..
कनिष्ठेऽस्तमिते भानौ सकृत्स्वर्गमवाप्नुयात् .. 17 ..
5.45.m: The person who bathes in the Eldest in the morning, in the Middle one at midday, / and in the Smallest when the sun has set, would at once attain heaven. 17

5.45.s:
tāvattiṣṭhati deheṣu pātakaṃ sarvadehinām ..
yāvanna pauṣkaraistoyaiḥ snānaṃ vai kurvate narāḥ .. 18 ..
5.45.d:
तावत्तिष्ठति देहेषु पातकं सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
यावन्न पौष्करैस्तोयैः स्नानं वै कुर्वते नराः .. 18 ..
5.45.m: Sin remains in the bodies of all embodied beings only as long / as men do not take a ritual ablution in the waters of Puṣkara. 18

5.45.s:
divākarakaraiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ tamo yadvatpraṇaśyati ..
puṣkarodakasaṃsparśācchīghraṃ gacchati pātakam .. 19 ..
5.45.d:
दिवाकरकरैः स्पृष्टं तमो यद्वत्प्रणश्यति ..
पुष्करोदकसंस्पर्शाच्छीघ्रं गच्छति पातकम् .. 19 ..
5.45.m: Just as darkness touched by the rays of the sun vanishes, / so through contact with the waters of Puṣkara does sin swiftly depart. 19

5.45.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ kṛtvāpi puruṣo bhuvi ..
kārtikyāṃ puṣkare snātvā nirdoṣatvaṃ prapadyate .. 6.45.20 ..
5.45.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं कृत्वापि पुरुषो भुवि ..
कार्तिक्यां पुष्करे स्नात्वा निर्दोषत्वं प्रपद्यते .. 6.45.20 ..
5.45.m: Even having committed sins such as killing a brahmin, a man on earth, / by bathing at Puṣkara on the full-moon day of Kārttika, attains guiltlessness. 20

5.45.s:
kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ vratairhomaiḥ kiṃ yajñairvahuvistaraiḥ ..
kārtikyāṃ puṣkare snānaiḥ sarveṣāṃ labhyate phalam .. 21 ..
5.45.d:
किं दानैः किं व्रतैर्होमैः किं यज्ञैर्वहुविस्तरैः ..
कार्तिक्यां पुष्करे स्नानैः सर्वेषां लभ्यते फलम् .. 21 ..
5.45.m: What need of gifts, what need of observances and burnt-offerings, what need of extensive sacrifices? / The fruit of all of them is obtained by bathing at Puṣkara on the full-moon day of Kārttika! 21

5.45.s:
yadyeṣā bhāratī satyā mayā samyamudīritā ..
tanme syāddarśanaṃ śīghraṃ sadyaḥ puṣkarasaṃbhavam .. 22 ..
5.45.d:
यद्येषा भारती सत्या मया सम्यमुदीरिता ..
तन्मे स्याद्दर्शनं शीघ्रं सद्यः पुष्करसंभवम् .. 22 ..
5.45.m: If this speech has been spoken truthfully by me with self-control, / then may there quickly be for me an immediate darśana of Puṣkara!” 22

5.45.s:
evaṃ tasya bruvāṇasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ..
aśarīrā'bhavadvāṇī gaganāddvijasattamāḥ .. 23 ..
5.45.d:
एवं तस्य ब्रुवाणस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ..
अशरीराऽभवद्वाणी गगनाद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 23 ..
5.45.m: As the wise Viśvāmitra was speaking thus, / a bodiless voice arose from the sky, O best of the twice-born: 23

5.45.s:
viśvāmitra muniśreṣṭha sadā me gagane sthitiḥ ..
muktvaikāṃ kārtikīṃ caiva kṛttikāyogasaṃyutām .. 24 ..
5.45.d:
विश्वामित्र मुनिश्रेष्ठ सदा मे गगने स्थितिः ..
मुक्त्वैकां कार्तिकीं चैव कृत्तिकायोगसंयुताम् .. 24 ..
5.45.m: “O Viśvāmitra, best of sages, my stay is always in the sky, / except on the single full-moon day of Kārttika joined with the asterism Kṛttikā. 24”

5.45.s:
tadatra divase vāso mama bhūmitale dhruvam ..
asminneva vane puṇye tattvaṃ snānaṃ samācara .. 25 ..
5.45.d:
तदत्र दिवसे वासो मम भूमितले ध्रुवम् ..
अस्मिन्नेव वने पुण्ये तत्त्वं स्नानं समाचर .. 25 ..
5.45.m: Therefore, on that day my dwelling is certainly on the earth's surface / in this very sacred forest; therefore, perform your ritual ablution. 25.

5.45.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ śrūyate ca samāśrayaḥ ..
tatkathaṃ vedmi tīrtheśa tvāmatraiva vyavasthitam .. 26 ..
5.45.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां श्रूयते च समाश्रयः ..
तत्कथं वेद्मि तीर्थेश त्वामत्रैव व्यवस्थितम् .. 26 ..
5.45.m: Viśvāmitra said: / You are heard to be the refuge of all sacred fords; / then how, O lord of sacred fords, may I know that you are present right here? 26.

5.45.s:
tadotthitā punarvāṇī tārā gaganagocarā ..
viśvāmitraṃ muniśreṣṭhaṃ harṣayaṃtī dvijottamāḥ .. 27 ..
5.45.d:
तदोत्थिता पुनर्वाणी तारा गगनगोचरा ..
विश्वामित्रं मुनिश्रेष्ठं हर्षयंती द्विजोत्तमाः .. 27 ..
5.45.m: Then there arose again a loud voice moving in the sky, / delighting Viśvāmitra, the best of sages, O best of brahmins: 27.

5.45.s:
nātidūre vanādasmādatra saṃti jalāśayāḥ ..
teṣāmekatame padmaṃ vidyate'dhomukhaṃ sthitam .. 28 ..
5.45.d:
नातिदूरे वनादस्मादत्र संति जलाशयाः ..
तेषामेकतमे पद्मं विद्यतेऽधोमुखं स्थितम् .. 28 ..
5.45.m: Not very far from this forest there are bodies of water here; / in one of them there is a lotus that stands facing downwards. 28.

5.45.s:
ūrdhvavaktraṃ dvitīye ca tiryagvaktraṃ tṛtīyake ..
tatrordhvāsyaiḥ sarojaiśca vijñeyaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkaram .. 29 ..
5.45.d:
ऊर्ध्ववक्त्रं द्वितीये च तिर्यग्वक्त्रं तृतीयके ..
तत्रोर्ध्वास्यैः सरोजैश्च विज्ञेयं ज्येष्ठपुष्करम् .. 29 ..
5.45.m: In the second, it faces upwards, and in the third, it faces sideways. / There, by the upward-facing lotuses Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara is to be recognized; 29.

5.45.s:
pārśvavaktrairdvijaśreṣṭha madhyamaṃ parikīrtitam ..
adhovaktraistathā jñeyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ puṣkaraṃ kṣitau .. 6.45.30 ..
5.45.d:
पार्श्ववक्त्रैर्द्विजश्रेष्ठ मध्यमं परिकीर्तितम् ..
अधोवक्त्रैस्तथा ज्ञेयं कनिष्ठं पुष्करं क्षितौ .. 6.45.30 ..
5.45.m: by the sideways-facing ones, O best of brahmins, the middle one is celebrated; / and by the downward-facing ones Kaniṣṭhapuṣkara on earth is to be known. 6.45.30.

5.45.s:
etaiścihnairmuniśreṣṭha jñātvā snānaṃ samācara ..
tacchrutvā sa munistūrṇaṃ samutthāya yayau tataḥ .. 31 ..
5.45.d:
एतैश्चिह्नैर्मुनिश्रेष्ठ ज्ञात्वा स्नानं समाचर ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनिस्तूर्णं समुत्थाय ययौ ततः .. 31 ..
5.45.m: Recognizing [them] by these signs, O best of sages, perform your ritual ablution. / Having heard that, the sage quickly rose and went from there. 31.

5.45.s:
tādṛśaiḥ kamalaistatra saṃsthitāste jalāśayāḥ ..
tāndṛṣṭvā śraddhayopetaḥ kṛtvā snānaṃ yathākramam .. 32 ..
5.45.d:
तादृशैः कमलैस्तत्र संस्थितास्ते जलाशयाः ..
तान्दृष्ट्वा श्रद्धयोपेतः कृत्वा स्नानं यथाक्रमम् .. 32 ..
5.45.m: Those bodies of water were situated there with such lotuses; / having seen them and being endowed with faith, he performed his ritual ablution in due order. 32.

5.45.s: tataśca vidhinā samyakcakārapitṛtarpaṇam .. 33 ..
5.45.d: ततश्च विधिना सम्यक्चकारपितृतर्पणम् .. 33 ..
5.45.m: And then, according to the rule, he properly performed the libation to the ancestors. 33.

5.45.s:
tataḥ śākaiśca mūlaiśca nīvāraiḥ phalasaṃyutaiḥ ..
cakāra vidhinā śrāddhaṃ tatraiva dvijasattamāḥ .. 34 ..
5.45.d:
ततः शाकैश्च मूलैश्च नीवारैः फलसंयुतैः ..
चकार विधिना श्राद्धं तत्रैव द्विजसत्तमाः .. 34 ..
5.45.m: Then with vegetables, roots, and wild grains accompanied by fruits, / he performed a śrāddha according to rule right there, O best of brahmins. 34.

5.45.s:
tatra tasyaiva tīrastho vīkṣāṃcakre samāhitaḥ ..
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge cihnadarśanalālasaḥ .. 35..
5.45.d:
तत्र तस्यैव तीरस्थो वीक्षांचक्रे समाहितः ..
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे चिह्नदर्शनलालसः .. 35..
5.45.m: Standing on its bank, concentrated in mind, he watched / on the Kārtika full moon day in the conjunction with Kṛttikā, eager to see the sign. 35.

5.45.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
kīdṛśaṃ jāyate cihnaṃ kārtikyāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
saṃprāpte kṛttikāyoge sarvaṃ tatra vadāśu naḥ .. 36 ..
5.45.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
कीदृशं जायते चिह्नं कार्तिक्यां ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ..
संप्राप्ते कृत्तिकायोगे सर्वं तत्र वदाशु नः .. 36 ..
5.45.m: The brahmins said: / What kind of sign arises on the Kārtika full moon day at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara / when the conjunction with Kṛttikā arrives? Tell us all that quickly! 36.

5.45.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yadā gacchati caṃdramāḥ ..
tadā niṣkrāmati śreṣṭhaṃ kamalaṃ jalamadhyataḥ .. 37 ..
5.45.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे यदा गच्छति चंद्रमाः ..
तदा निष्क्रामति श्रेष्ठं कमलं जलमध्यतः .. 37 ..
5.45.m: Sūta said: / On the Kārtika full moon day, when the moon enters into the conjunction with Kṛttikā, / then an extraordinary lotus emerges from the midst of the water. 37.

5.45.s:
tanmadhyeṃ'guṣṭhamātrastu puruṣo dṛśyate janaiḥ ..
