susnātaiḥ śraddhayopetaistatastīrthaphalaṃ labhet .. 38 ..
5.45.d:
तन्मध्येंऽगुष्ठमात्रस्तु पुरुषो दृश्यते जनैः ..
सुस्नातैः श्रद्धयोपेतैस्ततस्तीर्थफलं लभेत् .. 38 ..
5.45.m: In its center a person merely the size of a thumb is seen by people / who have bathed well and are endowed with faith; then one obtains the fruit of the sacred ford. 38.

5.45.s:
etasmātkāraṇātsnātvā viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
taccihnaṃ vīkṣayāmāsa mahadyatnaṃ samāśritaḥ .. .. 39 ..
5.45.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्स्नात्वा विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ..
तच्चिह्नं वीक्षयामास महद्यत्नं समाश्रितः .. .. 39 ..
5.45.m: For this reason, having bathed, the great sage Viśvāmitra / watched for that sign, applying great effort. 39.

5.45.s:
tasyaivaṃ vīkṣamāṇasya viśvāmitrasya dhīmataḥ ..
ānartādhipatistatra prāpto rājā bṛhadbalaḥ .. 6.45.40 ..
5.45.d:
तस्यैवं वीक्षमाणस्य विश्वामित्रस्य धीमतः ..
आनर्ताधिपतिस्तत्र प्राप्तो राजा बृहद्बलः .. 6.45.40 ..
5.45.m: As that wise Viśvāmitra was thus watching, / the ruler of Ānarta, King Bṛhadbala, arrived there, 6.45.40.

5.45.s:
atyaṃtaṃ mṛgayāśrāṃto hatvā mṛgagaṇānbahūn ..
ṛkṣāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca sāraṃgānatha saṃbarān .. 41 ..
5.45.d:
अत्यंतं मृगयाश्रांतो हत्वा मृगगणान्बहून् ..
ऋक्षांश्चैव वराहांश्च सारंगानथ संबरान् .. 41 ..
5.45.m: exceedingly exhausted from hunting, having slain many herds of deer, / bears, boars, antelopes, and sambar deer, 41.

5.45.s:
siṃhānvyāghrānvṛkāṃścaiva hiṃsānāraṇyacāriṇaḥ ..
tathānyānapi madhyāhne tena mārgeṇa saṃgataḥ .. 42 ..
5.45.d:
सिंहान्व्याघ्रान्वृकांश्चैव हिंसानारण्यचारिणः ..
तथान्यानपि मध्याह्ने तेन मार्गेण संगतः .. 42 ..
5.45.m: lions, tigers, wolves, and ferocious forest-dwellers, / as well as others; at midday he arrived along that path. 42.

5.45.s:
athāpaśyaddrumopāṃte viśvāmitraṃ munīśvaram ..
upaviṣṭaṃ kṛtasnānaṃ vīkṣamāṇaṃ jalāśayam .. 43 ..
5.45.d:
अथापश्यद्द्रुमोपांते विश्वामित्रं मुनीश्वरम् ..
उपविष्टं कृतस्नानं वीक्षमाणं जलाशयम् .. 43 ..
5.45.m: Then he saw Viśvāmitra, the lord of sages, near a tree, / seated, having completed his ritual ablution, watching the pool of water. 43.

5.45.s:
tatastaṃ praṇipatyoccairavatīrya turaṃgamāt ..
śramārttaḥ salile tasminpraviveśa nṛpottamaḥ .. 44 ..
5.45.d:
ततस्तं प्रणिपत्योच्चैरवतीर्य तुरंगमात् ..
श्रमार्त्तः सलिले तस्मिन्प्रविवेश नृपोत्तमः .. 44 ..
5.45.m: Then, having bowed to him respectfully and dismounted from his horse, / the best of kings, afflicted by fatigue, entered into that water. 44.

5.45.s:
etasminnaṃtare toyātkamalaṃ tadvinirgatam ..
sahasrapatrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham .. .. 45 ..
5.45.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तोयात्कमलं तद्विनिर्गतम् ..
सहस्रपत्रसंजुष्टं द्वादशार्कसमप्रभम् .. .. 45 ..
5.45.m: In that interval, that lotus emerged from the water, / endowed with a thousand petals, possessing a radiance equal to twelve suns. 45.

5.45.s:
taddṛṣṭvā sa mahīpālaḥ padmamatyadbhutaṃ mahat ..
jagrāha kautukāviṣṭaḥ svayaṃ savyena pāṇinā .. 46 ..
5.45.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा स महीपालः पद्ममत्यद्भुतं महत् ..
जग्राह कौतुकाविष्टः स्वयं सव्येन पाणिना .. 46 ..
5.45.m: Having seen that great, most wondrous lotus, the protector of the earth, / seized by curiosity, took hold of it with his own left hand. 46.

5.45.s:
spṛṣṭamātre tatastasminkamale dvijasattamāḥ ..
utthitaḥ sumahāñchabdo viśvaṃ yena prapūritam .. 47 ..
5.45.d:
स्पृष्टमात्रे ततस्तस्मिन्कमले द्विजसत्तमाः ..
उत्थितः सुमहाञ्छब्दो विश्वं येन प्रपूरितम् .. 47 ..
5.45.m: Then, as soon as that lotus was touched, O best of brahmins, / a very great sound arose, by which the universe was filled. 47.

5.45.s:
taṃ śabdaṃ sa mahīpālaḥ śrutvā mūrchāmupāviśat ..
patitaśca jale tasminpadmaṃ cādarśanaṃ gatam .. 48 ..
5.45.d:
तं शब्दं स महीपालः श्रुत्वा मूर्छामुपाविशत् ..
पतितश्च जले तस्मिन्पद्मं चादर्शनं गतम् .. 48 ..
5.45.m: Hearing that sound, the protector of the earth fell into a faint / and tumbled into that water, and the lotus vanished from sight. 48.

5.45.s:
tataḥ kṛcchreṇa mahatā karṣitaḥ salilādbahiḥ ..
sevakairduḥkhaśokārttairhāheti pratijalpakaiḥ .. 49 ..
5.45.d:
ततः कृच्छ्रेण महता कर्षितः सलिलाद्बहिः ..
सेवकैर्दुःखशोकार्त्तैर्हाहेति प्रतिजल्पकैः .. 49 ..
5.45.m: Then, with great difficulty, he was pulled out of the water / by his servants, who were afflicted with grief and sorrow, crying out: “Alas, alas!” 49.

5.45.s:
tatastīraṃ samāsādya kṛcchrātprāpyātha cetanām ..
yāvadvīkṣayati svāṃgaṃ tāvatkuṣṭhaṃ samāgatam .. 6.45.50 ..
5.45.d:
ततस्तीरं समासाद्य कृच्छ्रात्प्राप्याथ चेतनाम् ..
यावद्वीक्षयति स्वांगं तावत्कुष्ठं समागतम् .. 6.45.50 ..
5.45.m: Then, having reached the bank and regained consciousness with difficulty, / as soon as he looked at his own limbs, leprosy had set in. 6.45.50.

5.45.s:
tato viṣādamāpanno dṛṣṭvā tādṛṅnijaṃ vapuḥ ..
śīrṇaghrāṇāṃghrihastaṃ ca ghargharasvarasaṃyutam .. 51 ..
5.45.d:
ततो विषादमापन्नो दृष्ट्वा तादृङ्निजं वपुः ..
शीर्णघ्राणांघ्रिहस्तं च घर्घरस्वरसंयुतम् .. 51 ..
5.45.m: Then he was overwhelmed with dejection upon seeing such a body of his own, / with rotted nose, feet, and hands, and accompanied by a rattling voice. 51.

5.45.s:
atha gatvā muneḥ pārśve viśvāmitrasya bhūmipaḥ ..
uvāca vacanaṃ dīnaṃ bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. .. 52 ..
5.45.d:
अथ गत्वा मुनेः पार्श्वे विश्वामित्रस्य भूमिपः ..
उवाच वचनं दीनं बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा .. .. 52 ..
5.45.m: Then, going into the presence of the sage Viśvāmitra, the king / spoke miserable words in a voice choked with tears: 52.

5.45.s:
bhagavanpaśya me jātaṃ yādṛśaṃ vapureva hi ..
akasmādeva magnasya salile'tra vigarhitam .. 53 ..
5.45.d:
भगवन्पश्य मे जातं यादृशं वपुरेव हि ..
अकस्मादेव मग्नस्य सलिलेऽत्र विगर्हितम् .. 53 ..
5.45.m: “O lord, see what kind of body has indeed become mine, / suddenly and blameworthy, after diving into this water! 53.

5.45.s:
tatkiṃ pānīyadoṣo vā kiṃ vā bhūmermunī śvara ..
yenedṛksahasā yātaṃ vikṛtiṃ me śarīrakam .. 54 ..
5.45.d:
तत्किं पानीयदोषो वा किं वा भूमेर्मुनी श्वर ..
येनेदृक्सहसा यातं विकृतिं मे शरीरकम् .. 54 ..
5.45.m: Is it a defect of the water, then, or of the ground, O lord of sages, / through which my body has suddenly undergone such deformity?” 54.

5.45.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
sāvitraṃ padmamevaitadyatspṛṣṭaṃ bhūpate tvayā ..
ucchiṣṭena ravirmadhye svayaṃ yasya vyavasthitaḥ .. 55 ..
5.45.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
सावित्रं पद्ममेवैतद्यत्स्पृष्टं भूपते त्वया ..
उच्छिष्टेन रविर्मध्ये स्वयं यस्य व्यवस्थितः .. 55 ..
5.45.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “This was indeed a solar lotus that you touched, O king, / while being impure, in whose center the sun himself resides. 55.

5.45.s:
yadā syātkṛttikāyogaḥ kārtike māsi pārthiva ..
śaśāṃkasya tadā caitajjāyate pauṣkare jale .. 56 ..
5.45.d:
यदा स्यात्कृत्तिकायोगः कार्तिके मासि पार्थिव ..
शशांकस्य तदा चैतज्जायते पौष्करे जले .. 56 ..
5.45.m: When the conjunction with Kṛttikā of the moon occurs in the month of Kārtika, O king, / only then does this appear in the water of Puṣkara. 56.

5.45.s:
tadidaṃ puṣkaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ bhavānyatra śramāturaḥ ..
praviṣṭaḥ kārtikī cādya kṛttikāyogasaṃyutā .. 57 ..
5.45.d:
तदिदं पुष्करं ज्येष्ठं भवान्यत्र श्रमातुरः ..
प्रविष्टः कार्तिकी चाद्य कृत्तिकायोगसंयुता .. 57 ..
5.45.m: So this is Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara, where you, afflicted by fatigue, / entered; and today is the Kārtika full moon day endowed with the conjunction with Kṛttikā. 57.

5.45.s:
etadvīkṣya naro hyatra snānaṃ kuryājjalāśaye ..
śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim ..58..
5.45.d:
एतद्वीक्ष्य नरो ह्यत्र स्नानं कुर्याज्जलाशये ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्तः स गच्छति परां गतिम् ..58..
5.45.m: Having beheld this, a man who performs ritual ablution in this pool of water, / endowed with supreme faith, goes to the supreme state. 58.

5.45.s:
ucchiṣṭena tvayā rājanharaṇāya hi kevalam ..
etatsaroruhaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ tenedṛksaṃsthitaṃ phalam ..59.. ..
5.45.d:
उच्छिष्टेन त्वया राजन्हरणाय हि केवलम् ..
एतत्सरोरुहं स्पृष्टं तेनेदृक्संस्थितं फलम् ..59.. ..
5.45.m: By you, while impure, O king, merely to seize it, / this lotus was touched; therefore such a fruit has resulted.” 59.

5.45.s:
.. bṛhadbala uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ me syānmuniśreṣṭha kuṣṭhavyādhiparikṣayaḥ ..
tapasā niyamenāpi vratenāpi kṛtena vai .. 6.45.60 ..
5.45.d:
.. बृहद्बल उवाच .. ..
कथं मे स्यान्मुनिश्रेष्ठ कुष्ठव्याधिपरिक्षयः ..
तपसा नियमेनापि व्रतेनापि कृतेन वै .. 6.45.60 ..
5.45.m: Bṛhadbala said: / “How may the destruction of the disease of leprosy happen for me, O best of sages, / through austerity, restriction, or even an observed vow?” 6.45.60.

5.45.s:
.. viśvāmitra uvāca .. ..
ārādhaya sahasrāṃśumasminkṣetre mahīpate ..
tataḥ prāpsyasi saṃsiddhiṃ kuṣṭhanāśasamudbhavām .. 61 ..
5.45.d:
.. विश्वामित्र उवाच .. ..
आराधय सहस्रांशुमस्मिन्क्षेत्रे महीपते ..
ततः प्राप्स्यसि संसिद्धिं कुष्ठनाशसमुद्भवाम् .. 61 ..
5.45.m: Viśvāmitra said: / “Worship the thousand-rayed sun in this sacred field, O king; / then you will attain the perfection arising from the destruction of leprosy.” 61.

5.45.s:
tacchrutvā sa munervākyaṃ bhūmipālo bṛhadbalaḥ ..
tatkṣaṇātsthāpayāmāsa sūryasya pratimāṃ tadā .. 62 ..
5.45.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा स मुनेर्वाक्यं भूमिपालो बृहद्बलः ..
तत्क्षणात्स्थापयामास सूर्यस्य प्रतिमां तदा .. 62 ..
5.45.m: Having heard that speech of the sage, King Bṛhadbala / then immediately installed an image of the sun. 62.

5.45.s:
arcayāmāsa vidhivatpuṣpadhūpānulepanaiḥ ..
śraddhayā parayā yukto ravivāre viśeṣataḥ.. .. 63 ..
5.45.d:
अर्चयामास विधिवत्पुष्पधूपानुलेपनैः ..
श्रद्धया परया युक्तो रविवारे विशेषतः.. .. 63 ..
5.45.m: Endowed with supreme faith, he worshipped it according to the rule with flowers, incense, and ointments, / especially on Sunday, 63.

5.45.s:
upavāsaparo bhūtvā raktacandanasaṃyutaiḥ ..
pūjayanraktapuṣpaiśca śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ .. 64 ..
5.45.d:
उपवासपरो भूत्वा रक्तचन्दनसंयुतैः ..
पूजयन्रक्तपुष्पैश्च श्रद्धया परया युतः .. 64 ..
5.45.m: devoted to fasting, worshipping with red sandal and red flowers, / endowed with supreme faith. 64.

5.45.s:
tataḥ saṃvatsarasyāṃte sa babhūva mahīpatiḥ ..
kuṣṭha vyādhi vinirmukto dvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ .. 65 ..
5.45.d:
ततः संवत्सरस्यांते स बभूव महीपतिः ..
कुष्ठ व्याधि विनिर्मुक्तो द्वादशार्कसमप्रभः .. 65 ..
5.45.m: Then, at the end of a year, that protector of the earth / became freed from the disease of leprosy, possessing a radiance equal to twelve suns. 65.

5.45.s:
tataḥ svaṃ rājyamāsādya bhuktvā bhogānanekaśaḥ ..
dehāṃte dinanāthasya saṃprāpto maṃdiraṃ tathā .. 66 ..
5.45.d:
ततः स्वं राज्यमासाद्य भुक्त्वा भोगाननेकशः ..
देहांते दिननाथस्य संप्राप्तो मंदिरं तथा .. 66 ..
5.45.m: Then, having returned to his own kingdom and enjoyed many pleasures, / at the end of his body he reached the abode of the lord of the day. 66.

5.45.s:
.. .. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā ..
prakaṭaṃ sarvalokasya vihitaṃ puṣkaratrayam .. 67 ..
5.45.d:
.. .. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं तत्र द्विजश्रेष्ठा विश्वामित्रेण धीमता ..
प्रकटं सर्वलोकस्य विहितं पुष्करत्रयम् .. 67 ..
5.45.m: Sūta said: / Thus there, O best of brahmins, by the wise Viśvāmitra / the three Puṣkaras were made manifest for all the world.

5.45.s:
yastatra kārtike māse kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāsu ca ..
prakaroti naraḥ snānaṃ brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 68 ..
5.45.d:
यस्तत्र कार्तिके मासे कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकासु च ..
प्रकरोति नरः स्नानं ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छति .. 68 ..
5.45.m: A man who performs a ritual ablution there in the month of Kārttika on the full-moon day and under the Kṛttikās / goes to the world of Brahmā.

5.45.s:
tathā yo bhāskaraṃ paśyedbṛhadvalapratiṣṭhitam ..
vatsaraṃ ravivāreṇa yāvatkṛtvā kṣaṇaṃ naraḥ ..
sa mucyate naro rogairyadi syādrogasaṃyutaḥ .. 69 ..
5.45.d:
तथा यो भास्करं पश्येद्बृहद्वलप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
वत्सरं रविवारेण यावत्कृत्वा क्षणं नरः ..
स मुच्यते नरो रोगैर्यदि स्याद्रोगसंयुतः .. 69 ..
5.45.m: Likewise, a man who beholds the Sun installed by Bṛhadbala / for a year on Sundays, taking only a moment, / that man is freed from diseases, if he is afflicted with disease.

5.45.s:
nīrogo vā naraḥ sadyo labhate manasepsitam ..
niṣkāmo mokṣamāpnoti prasādāttīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ .. 6.45.70 ..
5.45.d:
नीरोगो वा नरः सद्यो लभते मनसेप्सितम् ..
निष्कामो मोक्षमाप्नोति प्रसादात्तीक्ष्णदीधितेः .. 6.45.70 ..
5.45.m: Or if healthy, a man immediately obtains his heart's desire; / free from desires, he attains liberation by the grace of the Sun.

5.45.s:
kārttikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge vṛṣotsargaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
puṣkareṣu supuṇyeṣu so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 71 ..
5.45.d:
कार्त्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे वृषोत्सर्गं करोति यः ..
पुष्करेषु सुपुण्येषु सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 71 ..
5.45.m: He who sets free a bull at the sacred Puṣkaras / on the full-moon day of Kārttika during the conjunction with Kṛttikā obtains the fruit of an Aśvamedha.

5.45.s:
eṣṭavyā bahavaḥ putrā yadyekopi gayāṃ vrajet ..
yajeta vā'śvamedhena nīlaṃ vā vṛṣamutsṛjet .. 72 ..
5.45.d:
एष्टव्या बहवः पुत्रा यद्येकोपि गयां व्रजेत् ..
यजेत वाऽश्वमेधेन नीलं वा वृषमुत्सृजेत् .. 72 ..
5.45.m: Many sons should be desired, so that if even one goes to Gayā, / or sacrifices with an Aśvamedha, or sets free a dark bull.

5.45.s:
ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni sarvadānāni caikataḥ ..
ekatastu vṛṣotsargaḥ kārtikyāṃ puṣkareṣu ca .. 73 ..
5.45.d:
एकतः सर्वतीर्थानि सर्वदानानि चैकतः ..
एकतस्तु वृषोत्सर्गः कार्तिक्यां पुष्करेषु च .. 73 ..
5.45.m: On one side are all the sacred fords and all the gifts; / on the other side is the setting free of a bull at the Puṣkaras on the full-moon day of Kārttika.

5.45.s:
yaścaitacchuṇuyānnityaṃ paṭhedvā śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
saṃprāpya sarvakāmānvai brahmaloke mahīyate .. 74 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye tripuṣkaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 45 .. .. cha ..
5.45.d:
यश्चैतच्छुणुयान्नित्यं पठेद्वा श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
संप्राप्य सर्वकामान्वै ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 74 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये त्रिपुष्करमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 45 .. .. छ ..
5.45.m:
And whoever hears this constantly, or recites it endowed with faith, / having attained all desires indeed, is honoured in the world of Brahmā.
Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Three Puṣkaras', in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the glorification of the sacred field of the glorious Hāṭakeśvara.
